jobs.title: Product Development Coordinator / Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Product Development Coordinator**

Pomona, CA (on-site)  
**Pay:** $25.00 – $35.00/hour, DOE (non-exempt) + bonus eligibility  
**Schedule:** Full-time

**About the Company**  
Our client is a well-established contract manufacturer of personal care, cosmetic, household, and consumer products. They have more than 30 years in business, around 400 employees across two manufacturing facilities, and they've roughly doubled in size over the past four years. With new investment behind them and continued expansion ahead, they're building out their team and investing in new systems, technology, and employee development. Employees describe the culture as family-oriented and people-first. Leadership is accessible and transparent, and there's a real emphasis on appreciation through company events, recognition programs, and community involvement.

**The Role**  
The Product Development Coordinator is the project quarterback for new and revised products, from the first customer inquiry through commercialization. You'll be the central point of coordination between Sales, R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and Production, making sure products move from concept to finished goods on time and within cost targets. You'll report to the Director of Project Management and partner directly with Sales and customers to bring wet wipe and filled products to market. This role suits someone who thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and enjoys juggling multiple customer projects at once.

**What You'll Do**

*Project Coordination & Execution*

* Coordinate the full product development process, from the initial customer inquiry and questionnaire through production launch and handoff to commercialization.
* Execute each phase of development, including bill of materials, cost analysis, claims testing, prototype sample submission, and customer approval.
* Prioritize work across multiple concurrent projects, adjust workflows as needed, and track progress against the timelines committed to customers.
* Manage the transition from development to production, confirming that specs, BOMs, artwork, and component orders are finalized before the first production run.
* Maintain project documentation, including approvals, change requests, test results, and stage-gate milestones.

*Cross-Functional Liaison*

* Serve as the main point of contact across Sales, R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and Production throughout the development lifecycle.
* Keep Sales and customers informed with project updates, timelines, and status reports, and communicate risks or delays proactively.
* Contribute ideas for new product formats, packaging configurations, and formulation approaches.
* Partner with Regulatory/Compliance on ingredient reviews, labeling, and claims substantiation so products meet FDA, OTC monograph, and cosmetic regulations.

*Technical & Commercial Support*

* Determine packaging materials and sourcing requirements, including substrates, film structures, flow wrap and pouch formats, and component lead times.
* Keep product specifications, BOMs, and documentation accurate and current in the ERP system.
* Support customer-specific cost models and help prepare quotes in partnership with Sales and Finance.
* Review artwork and proofs with internal teams and customers so that components can be ordered on schedule.
* Apply your understanding of line capabilities, MOQs, changeover constraints, and material lead times to set realistic timelines.

**What You Bring**

* A bachelor's degree in Business, Chemistry, Cosmetic Science, Packaging Science, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in project management, product development, or project coordination within the cosmetic, personal care, household, or CPG industry.
* Experience in a contract manufacturing (OEM) environment is strongly preferred, and manufacturing or production floor experience is a plus.
* A working understanding of packaging development, pouching and flow wrapping, formulation basics, manufacturing processes, and QA.
* Familiarity with FDA cosmetic and OTC monograph frameworks and with ingredient labeling is a plus.
* Strong Excel skills; experience with Salesforce, an ERP system (SAP, DEACOM, or similar), and project management tools is a plus.
* Strong organization and follow-through, an analytical, root-cause mindset, and confidence presenting project status to customers and leadership.
* A positive, adaptable approach and comfort in an environment where priorities shift and speed matters.

**Why You'll Love It**

* A growing company where new opportunities open up as the business expands.
* A collaborative, family-oriented culture with visible, approachable leadership.
* Regular employee appreciation events, recognition programs, and community giving.
* A growing investment in training and professional development.
* Exposure to a wide range of products and well-known brands.

**Work Environment**  
This is primarily an office-based role with occasional time on the manufacturing floor, where there is some exposure to fumes, airborne particles, moving mechanical parts, and vibration. The role involves occasional lifting of up to 20 lbs. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**

The Lundquist Institute for Biomedical Innovation at Harbor-UCLA Medical Center (TLI) is Los Angeles County's preeminent independent, not-for-profit biomedical research hub, excelling in transforming scientific breakthroughs into practical therapies. With a $90 million annual budget, TLI is home to over 150 investigators and 500 staff, advancing 600 projects in areas such as Infection and Immunity, Cancer, and Women's Health. Founded in 1952, the Institute continues to train physician-scientists and manage healthcare programs for 60,000 underserved families throughout South Los Angeles.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Coordinate activities and follow up on assignments involving administrative support personnel as delegated by division leadership.
* Maintain clear escalation pathways, workflow documentation, and continuity of administrative operations.
* Serve as a central administrative contact for faculty, staff, trainees, and institutional offices;
* Route requests to the appropriate resource and follow up on unresolved matters.
* Prepare and distribute divisional announcements, reminders, operational notices, and other communications as directed.

Manage scheduling, room reservations, calendar invitations, audiovisual and virtual-meeting readiness, speaker or participant logistics, and approved travel arrangements. Prepare and distribute agendas, invitations, event materials, reminders, and follow-up communications. Provide on-site and virtual event support; coordinate approved food, transportation, lodging, and related services in accordance with institutional policies. Capture action items, confirm owners and deadlines assigned by division leadership, maintain tracking logs, and escalate items at risk of delay.
* Coordinate required evaluations, monitor completion, route materials to the appropriate institutional contact, and maintain records for internal reporting and faculty dossier support.
* Coordinate administrative steps associated with approved recruitment, hiring, onboarding, personnel changes, and offboarding in partnership with Human Resources and division leadership. Support job-posting requests, interview scheduling, candidate communications, and visit logistics. Collect, review for completeness, and route required forms and documentation, including applicable clearance and hospital-access materials. Coordinate administrative orientation and operational readiness for new employees, students, interns, and other trainees. Coordinate offboarding checklists, access changes, and return of institutional property with the responsible departments. Maintain appropriate confidentiality and promptly refer employee-relations matters to Human Resources and division leadership.
* Serve as the operational timekeeper and leave coordinator for assigned personnel in accordance with TLI and Harbor-UCLA requirements and delegated authority.
* Review timecards, punch corrections, and leave requests for accuracy and completeness; approve or route items for approval as authorized. Communicate submission deadlines and send timely reminders to employees and approvers. Research routine discrepancies with employees and coordinate resolution with Payroll, Human Resources, or other responsible offices. Maintain accurate records and escalate unresolved or time-sensitive issues to prevent payroll disruption.
* Prepare, route, and track purchase requisitions, purchase orders, blanket orders, reimbursements, and related documentation using institution-approved processes.
* Verify required supporting documentation, project or account information, and approvals; coordinate questions and discrepancy resolution with Purchasing, Accounting, Finance, and requestors. Maintain organized purchasing and reimbursement records and provide timely status updates. Coordinate office supplies, mail, checks, printing, scanning, copying, divisional phone coverage, and distribution or tracking of operational items such as lab coats. Submit and monitor service requests involving facilities, custodial services, information technology, badges, workspaces, office equipment, temperature, and audiovisual needs. Follow established emergency and safety-reporting procedures for workplace injuries, spills, or other urgent issues and promptly notify the appropriate safety personnel and division leadership.

jobs.title: Research Coordinator I
jobs.description:
The Department of Population and Public Health Sciences at the Keck School of Medicine at USC has an immediate opening for a bilingual (English-Spanish) Research Coordinator I to assist in the *All of Us Research Program* funded by the National Institutes of Health. This position will report to the USC Principal Investigator.

***All of Us*** **Research Program Goals and Summary**

The *All of Us* Research Program is funded by the National Institutes of Health and part of the Precision Medicine Initiative. It seeks to build one of the largest, most diverse biomedical data resources of its kind, with information gathered from 1 million + participants across America. This program will be one of the most diverse health databases in history. Researchers will use the data to learn how our biology, lifestyle, and environment affect health. This may one day help them find ways to treat and prevent disease. *All of Us* is building a diverse database that can inform thousands of studies on a variety of health conditions.

**Job Responsibilities include but are not limited to**:

* Present the *All of Us* Research Program opportunity to eligible patients at Keck Medicine, LA General, and partnering clinics (in person or by phone).
* Interact with clinic staff as needed to create partnerships and increase support of the program.
* Help enroll interested participants by assisting with the consent process and survey completion through the *All of Us* research portal.
* Take physical measurements, vital signs and assist with biospecimen collection activities
* Contact potential participants to complete retention activities
* Use REDCap to document all patient contacts for both recruitment and retention

Performs other related duties as assigned or requested.

**Minimum qualifications**:

* Bachelor’s degree
* Willing and able to travel to off-site locations approximately once/week
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and verbal communication
* Bilingual (English-Spanish)

**Please be advised this is a fixed term position ending 5/31/2027 with the possibility of renewal.**

The salary range for this position is $34.80. * Passionate and motivated.
* Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit.
* Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed
Reliable and dedicated with a can-do attitude. Encourage and build mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.

jobs.title: Production Assistant
jobs.description:
Our Culver City team creates experiential and brand events designed to bring people together. We are looking for a hands-on Production Assistant who can help keep the practical details organized, from the first production schedule through setup, live delivery, and final breakdown.

This is a varied position for someone who enjoys creative environments but also understands that successful events depend on timing, preparation, teamwork, and attention to detail. You will work directly with producers, project leads, creative teams, vendors, and on-site event partners.

**From planning to live delivery**

* Update production calendars, run sheets, contact lists, and project trackers.
* Confirm schedules and practical details with venues, vendors, and suppliers.
* Organize signage, event materials, equipment, samples, and guest supplies.
* Prepare production packs and distribute current information to the team.
* Support venue walkthroughs, setup, registration, and attendee movement.
* Communicate schedule changes to production leads and event partners.
* Track equipment and materials during load-in, live delivery, and breakdown.
* Organize receipts, delivery notes, photographs, and post-event records.

**The pace of the work**

Some days will be spent preparing documents and coordinating details from the Culver City office. Others may involve packing event materials, checking deliveries, assisting at a venue, or helping the production team respond when plans change.

**A useful starting point**

We are interested in someone who:

* Communicates clearly and asks questions when details are unclear.
* Keeps track of deadlines, materials, and changing priorities.
* Enjoys working with creative and operational colleagues.
* Takes initiative without losing sight of instructions.
* Is comfortable using email, spreadsheets, calendars, and shared documents.
* Can travel locally to event sites when scheduled.

Paid training will cover production procedures, event documentation, venue coordination, and on-site expectations. As your experience develops, there may be opportunities to take ownership of larger parts of the production process.

Apply with your current resume to be considered for the **Production Assistant** position in Culver City.

jobs.description:
Description:

**E-Commerce & Digital Marketing Coordinator**
==============================================

**Position:** E-Commerce & Digital Marketing Coordinator  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Department:** Marketing / E-Commerce  
**Reports To:** Owner / Management

**Position Summary**
--------------------

We are looking for a motivated, organized, and creative **E-Commerce & Digital Marketing Coordinator** to help manage and grow our online presence across multiple websites, e-commerce marketplaces, and social media platforms.

This is a hands-on position for someone who is comfortable working with websites, product listings, Amazon, eBay, social media, blogs, basic graphic design, and video content.

The ideal candidate is someone who can take direction but also work independently, identify things that need improvement, and continually help us improve our websites, product listings, content, and overall digital presence.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Website & E-Commerce Management**

* Add new products to company websites.
* Update existing products, descriptions, specifications, images, pricing, and categories.
* Maintain accurate and consistent product information across multiple websites.
* Improve product titles and descriptions for customers and search engines.
* Create and update website categories and landing pages.
* Identify outdated information, broken links, missing images, and other website issues.
* Assist with basic SEO improvements.
* Help improve website navigation and the overall customer experience.
* Upload product images, documents, specification sheets, and videos.
* Assist with promotions, banners, featured products, and website updates.

### **Amazon & eBay**

* Create and maintain product listings on Amazon and eBay.
* Update product titles, descriptions, images, pricing, and specifications.
* Improve listings for better search visibility and conversion.
* Monitor listings for errors, missing information, or suppressed products.
* Help organize product variations, SKUs, categories, and product information.
* Research competing listings and identify opportunities to improve ours.
* Assist with marketplace promotions and new product launches.
* Maintain consistent branding and product information across marketplaces.

### **Blogs, SEO & Content**

* Assist with writing, editing, formatting, and publishing company blog articles.
* Update older blog articles with current information, images, links, and keywords.
* Research topics that potential customers are searching for.
* Help create educational content around our products, industries, and applications.
* Assist with basic keyword research and search engine optimization.
* Create internal links between articles, products, and important website pages.
* Help turn technical product information into easy-to-understand customer content.

### **Social Media**

Help create and manage content for platforms such as:

* LinkedIn
* Instagram
* Facebook
* YouTube
* TikTok and other relevant platforms

Responsibilities include creating posts, product spotlights, educational content, promotions, short videos, industry information, customer applications, and behind-the-scenes manufacturing content.

The coordinator will also help maintain a regular content calendar and schedule posts consistently.

### **Video & Creative Content**

* Help plan, record, edit, and publish short-form and long-form videos.
* Create product demonstration videos.
* Create how-to and educational videos.
* Film products, equipment, manufacturing processes, and customer applications.
* Turn longer videos into shorter clips for social media.
* Add basic titles, captions, graphics, music, and branding to videos.
* Upload and optimize videos for YouTube and social media.
* Help develop ideas for new video and marketing content.

### **Marketing Support**

* Assist management with digital marketing projects.
* Help create email marketing content and promotions.
* Assist with product launches and promotional campaigns.
* Research competitors and industry trends.
* Help create digital flyers, advertisements, product graphics, and promotional materials.
* Maintain organized digital files for product images, videos, specifications, and marketing materials.
* Look for new opportunities to generate traffic, leads, and online sales.

Requirements:

**Ideal Candidate**
-------------------

We are looking for someone who is:

* Highly organized and detail-oriented.
* Comfortable learning new software and technology.
* Creative and willing to generate new ideas.
* Able to manage multiple projects at the same time.
* A good writer and communicator.
* Comfortable working independently.
* Interested in e-commerce, marketing, social media, and technology.
* Willing to learn our products and industries.
* Comfortable taking photos and videos.
* Able to take a project from an idea through completion.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

**Amazon Seller Central • eBay • BigCommerce • Shopify • WordPress • Canva • Adobe Creative Suite • CapCut • YouTube • Instagram • Facebook • LinkedIn • TikTok • Google Analytics • Google Ads • SEO • Email Marketing • AI tools such as ChatGPT**

Experience with every platform is **not required**. We are looking for someone who is technologically capable, motivated to learn, and able to get things done.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

Success in this position means our websites and marketplaces stay current, new products get online quickly, product information is accurate, blogs and social media are updated consistently, videos and marketing content are produced regularly, and our overall digital presence continues to improve.

This person should ultimately become the **go-to person for keeping our online business organized, updated, and growing.**

Description:

**Sales Representative – Labels & Packaging**
=============================================

**Focus Industries:** Cosmetics • Beauty • Personal Care • Pharmaceutical • Nutraceutical • Cannabis • Consumer Packaged Goods

**Position:** Senior Sales Representative – Labels & Packaging  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Department:** Sales / Business Development  
**Reports To:** Owner / Sales Management

**Position Summary**
--------------------

We are seeking an experienced, highly motivated **Labels & Packaging Sales Representative** with an established network of customers and industry contacts within the **cosmetics, beauty, personal care, pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, cannabis, and consumer packaged goods industries**.

This is **not an entry-level sales position**.

We are specifically looking for an experienced salesperson who understands the pressure-sensitive label and packaging industry and has existing relationships with companies that regularly purchase **custom labels, product labels, packaging labels, variable-data labels, specialty labels, and related packaging products**.

The ideal candidate has a proven history of developing and managing B2B accounts and established relationships with decision-makers responsible for labels and packaging, including purchasing managers, packaging engineers, operations managers, brand owners, production managers, supply-chain professionals, contract manufacturers, co-packers, and other packaging buyers.

The primary objective of this position is to **develop new business, bring qualified opportunities into the company, grow existing accounts, and build long-term customer relationships.**

**Target Markets**
------------------

The Sales Representative will focus primarily on companies within:

* Cosmetics and beauty
* Skin care
* Hair care
* Personal care
* Pharmaceutical
* Nutraceutical and supplement
* Cannabis and hemp
* Contract manufacturing
* Co-packing and private-label manufacturing
* Food and beverage
* Wine and spirits
* Household and consumer products
* Other high-volume consumer packaged goods industries

**Products & Solutions**
------------------------

The representative will sell a broad range of label and packaging solutions, including:

* Custom pressure-sensitive labels
* Prime product labels
* Digital printed labels
* Flexographic labels
* Short- and long-run label programs
* Paper labels
* White, clear, silver, and specialty BOPP labels
* Clear and no-label-look labels
* Foil and metallic labels
* Holographic labels
* Spot UV and specialty embellished labels
* Tamper-evident labels
* Variable-data and serialized labels
* QR code and barcode labels
* RFID labels
* Thermal-transfer and direct-thermal labels
* Regulatory and compliance labels
* Specialty packaging products
* Custom label application solutions

**Primary Responsibilities**
----------------------------

* Generate new business within targeted industries.
* Leverage an existing professional network to identify label and packaging opportunities.
* Prospect and develop new accounts.
* Contact purchasing managers, packaging engineers, operations managers, brand managers, owners, and other decision-makers.
* Develop relationships with contract manufacturers, co-packers, private-label manufacturers, and other companies that influence packaging purchasing decisions.

* Manage quotes and follow up aggressively until opportunities are won or closed.
* Maintain an active sales pipeline.
* Develop both transactional and long-term contractual business.
* Grow existing accounts through additional products, applications, locations, and divisions.
* Attend relevant industry trade shows, networking events, and customer meetings.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, opportunities, follow-ups, and forecasts.
* Consistently achieve sales, gross-profit, and new-account targets.

Ideal candidates may already have relationships with:

* Cosmetic and beauty brands
* Cannabis brands and multi-state operators

* Nutraceutical and supplement manufacturers
* Contract manufacturers
* Private-label manufacturers

* Packaging engineers
* Purchasing departments
* Operations executives
* Brand managers

Candidates with an existing book of relationships and the ability to quickly generate qualified opportunities will receive strong consideration.

-----------------------

* Demonstrated understanding of pressure-sensitive labels and packaging.
* Proven ability to develop new accounts.

* Ability to understand technical product specifications and communicate solutions to customers.

* Ability to manage opportunities from initial contact through quoting, sampling, production, and ongoing account management.
* Comfortable working independently and being accountable for measurable sales results.

**Preferred Candidate**

jobs.title: Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Production Coordinator**  
*Updated: September 19, 2026*

**Company:** PALY Hollywood  
**Location:** Los Angeles, CA (on-site)  
**Reports to:** Production Manager  
**Department:** Production  
**Employment:** Full-time

**ABOUT PALY**

PALY embodies the act of storytelling. Through the release of seasonal collections, the brand explores a range of subjects, with an emphasis on Hollywood history, infamous crimes, conspiracies, drug tales, and the cult phenomenon.

Rooted in carefully referenced alternative motifs, scribbled drawings, and delicate hand-worked detailing, PALY presents a vision of luxury clothing that feels authentically vintage. Each piece bears an individual, one-of-one quality. These sensibilities are reimagined through the distinctive lens of film and Hollywood iconography.

Founded in 2022 and based in Los Angeles, PALY has grown quickly across wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels, with distribution in North America, the EU, the Middle East, and Asia. We are at the stage where the brand is moving faster than the operating infrastructure beneath it.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

The Production Coordinator keeps production moving. The role owns the day-to-day detail behind the calendar: purchase orders, ERP entry, sample movement, follow-up with vendors, and the records that let everyone else work from accurate information.

This role is the difference between a calendar that exists on paper and one the company can trust. Accuracy and follow-through matter more here than seniority.

This is a hands-on, on-site role with real growth potential into production management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Purchase Orders & ERP Entry**

* Write and enter fabric, trim, and production purchase orders accurately and on time
* Enter and maintain style setup, cost sheets, fabric content, and country of origin in Sync
* Apply and manage UPCs for all styles moving into production
* Audit style master information before collection launch and correct errors before they move downstream
* Inactivate styles that do not move forward to sales or production
* Maintain accurate size, color, and SKU data so allocation and shipping are not working from bad information

**Calendar & WIP Support**

* Maintain the style-level WIP and update it in the ERP no less than weekly
* Track every style against its calendar milestones and flag anything slipping
* Chase vendors for confirmations, updated dates, and missing information
* Prepare the weekly production report for the Director of Production and the sales team
* Maintain the pre-production calendar and keep deadlines visible to design, development, and production

**Sample Tracking & Movement**

* Track proto, fit, salesman, TOP, and photoshoot samples from request through receipt
* Log, label, and organize samples so any style can be located on demand
* Pick up and deliver samples across factories, wash houses, printers, and the office
* Coordinate sample sets for market, trade shows, photoshoots, and PR, and confirm each set is complete before it leaves
* Follow up on outstanding samples so approvals are not the reason a date is missed

**Materials & Vendor Follow-Up**

* Track fabric, trim, and treatment orders in transit and confirm arrival against need dates
* Chase lab dips, strike-offs, and trim submits through approval
* Flag shortages and substitutions early, before they stop a cut
* Maintain vendor contact records, terms, and compliance documentation

**Receiving & Warehouse Coordination**

* Coordinate inbound receiving between the factories, Sync, and the warehouse team
* Confirm received quantities by style, color, and size against the purchase order, and raise discrepancies
* Support invoice review by verifying that what was received matches what is billed
* Conduct on-site visits to factories and the warehouse to check quality and progress

**Quality & Records**

* Assist with quality control, including review of samples and bulk before release
* Support fit sessions by preparing samples, taking notes, and distributing comments
* Maintain detailed, organized records of production workflows, adjustments, and outcomes
* Review vendor compliance requirements per customer and check for changes quarterly

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required**

* 2+ years in apparel production, production coordination, or a closely related support role
* Working knowledge of an apparel ERP or PLM system
* Strong Excel skills
* Exceptional organization, accuracy, and follow-through
* Comfortable chasing people for answers and persistent about getting them
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation for sample runs and factory visits
* Basic understanding of garment construction, fabric, and wash

**Preferred**

* Experience in luxury, contemporary, or elevated streetwear
* Experience with washed or garment-dyed product

jobs.description:
At Seaman Corporation, every associate is instrumental to our success. Become a part of our growing team!
  
  
WHO WE ARE
  
At Seaman Corporation, we are dedicated to creating and supplying quality, high-performance fabrics that protect our planet, our people, and our customers. From humble beginnings in 1949 to a multi-million-dollar organization, this family-owned business has grown to be a leading manufacturer in highly durable coated fabrics, supplying products to customers around the globe.
  
Every Seaman Corporation associate plays a valuable role in our company’s continuous growth. We believe by investing in the right people and resources, we can drive sustainable growth across the entire business.
  
Seaman Corporation products are composed of proprietary knitted or woven base fabrics and coating formulas to produce high performance roofing systems, geomembrane liners, truck tarps, architectural structures, and much more. We work exclusively with authorized fabricators, designers, consultants, engineers, and installers for quality solutions, start to finish.

* Analyze and control expenditures of territory to conform to budgetary requirements.

* Assist in coordinating the annual customer service survey, share feedback and use feedback to improve individual and team results.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Bachelor’s degree Business, Registered Roof Observer, Construction Management, Engineering, Project Management or a related degree with 3- 5 years related experience in roofing industry or related building products industry; or equivalent combination of education and experience

jobs.description:
Convoso is a leading AI-powered contact center platform purpose-built for revenue teams. Since 2006, Convoso has remained at the forefront of innovation, consistently developing solutions to drive customer growth while supporting adherence to regulatory standards.

**Who We Are:**

While headquartered in Los Angeles, the Convoso team can be found around the globe working in either a hybrid or remote capacity. Awarded as a "best place to work" company, our culture fosters team integrity, positive persistence, and continuous growth.  
  
Our core platform powers successful sales teams across multiple industries, giving our customers a competitive edge and streamlined productivity. With built-in Al and automations, our product is a premium offering in a competitive space. We continue to grow our product capabilities to better serve our current customers and to expand into newer markets.  
  
Convoso is looking for people who are excited about technology and innovation. We are a company of motivated team players with diverse backgrounds driving accelerated growth in a supportive, positive culture.

Most roles at Convoso function as "hybrid" with some opportunities for travel to in-person business events and company meetings. For remote positions, Convoso's U.S. hiring is open to candidates residing anywhere within the United States.

**The Job:**

The SDR, Outbound owns self-sourced pipeline generation into a targeted list of named accounts. This is an outbound-first role. The incumbent builds their own account and contact lists, multithreads into multiple stakeholders per account, and converts cold conversations into qualified meetings for the Account Executive team. Inbound lead coverage may be assigned during the current transition period, but outbound production is the primary measure of the role.

**Responsibilities summary:**

  

* Build, own and maintain a targeted list of named accounts. Research accounts and contacts independently rather than working an assigned queue.
* Generate self-sourced pipeline through high-volume, high-quality outbound calling, email and LinkedIn outreach.
* Multithread into target accounts, developing and maintaining multiple stakeholder relationships per account over time.
* Design, run and refine outbound campaigns, cadences and sequences. Test messaging and adjust based on results.
* Qualify prospects against Convoso's current ICP and qualification criteria, and pre-wire and hand off qualified meetings to the Account Executive team.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, disposition reasons and account ownership.
* Provide inbound lead coverage as assigned during the current transition period. Inbound coverage is secondary to outbound production.
* Stay informed of all new product information.
* Be accountable for your outbound targets.
* Other duties as assigned

**Who You Are:**

* 3+ years in an outbound-focused SDR or BDR role in B2B SaaS, with a demonstrable record of self-sourced pipeline. Inbound lead-response experience alone will not substitute.
* Proven success cold calling at volume, including the ability to open and hold a conversation with a prospect who is not expecting the call.
* Experience with account-based, multithreaded prospecting into mid-market or enterprise accounts.
* Demonstrated ability to build target lists and conduct account research independently, without a pre-assigned lead queue.
* Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills. Professional presence on video and by phone, including the ability to take video calls from a quiet, distraction-free environment.
* Outstanding organization and follow-up skills, as well as strong prospecting skills.
* Strong understanding of outbound pipeline generation processes and the metrics that govern them.
* Proficiency with Salesforce, Outreach or a comparable sales engagement platform, and Gong or a comparable conversation intelligence platform.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant work experience.
* Enthusiastic and vibrant attitude.

**Work Perks Worth The Hype:**

* Competitive compensation package
* Stock options
* 100% covered premiums for employees; Medical, Dental, Basic life insurance, Long term disability
* Affordable Vision plan and optional FSA
* PTO, Paid Sick Time, Holidays, Bereavement time, Parental Leave
* Your birthday off
* 401k program with generous company match
* No cost Employee Assistance Program and Travel Assistance
* Monthly Gym membership reimbursement
* Monthly credits toward food & beverage
* Company Outings
* On and offsite team building events
* Paid training for departments
* Apple laptop (most roles)
* And a team of highly experienced and kind colleagues!
* HQ Office:
* Casual office environment & dress
* Daily catered lunches
* Fully stocked kitchen (Dietary restriction-friendly)
* Happy Hours
* On-site Car Wash
* Free Parking

**Compensation:**  
  
The base salary range is: $55,000 - $58,000

The Base Pay Range for this position is based on the industry benchmark for position, function, level and the company's compensation strategies. However, final offers may vary from the amount listed based on geography, candidate experience and expertise, and other objective business. Convoso's compensation package also includes equity for all eligible U.S full time roles and exceptional benefits, including generous 401k match.

As a California resident who is an applicant to be an employee of Convoso, you have certain rights under California law with respect to information collected by Convoso in the course and scope of its evaluation of your application. The types of information Convoso collects and your rights with respect to that information are contained in Convoso's privacy policy, which you can review by going to https://www.convoso.com/privacy-policy/.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative – Aerospace & Space
jobs.description:
**Overview**

BSU Electronics is a 35+ year old, ITAR-registered contract electronics manufacturer building high-reliability PCBAs for government agencies and advanced-technology OEMs.

We build mission critical parts for underwater autonomous naval vessels, moon landings, anti-missile drones and roller coaster rides, to name a few. Our engineering heavy team take on the complex builds that other shops turn away. NPI? Quick turn? We’ve got you.

Few places in the world concentrate as much space and aerospace hardware demand as El Segundo and the South Bay. It’s one of our fastest growing geographies, and that’s the territory you'll own. This is an exceptional opportunity to ride the unprecedented wave of investment and innvoation in SoCal right now.

Our ideal candidate has spent a few years in space or aerospace, in engineering, test, quality, program management, supply chain, or sales. You know how flight and defense hardware gets bought, who has a say, and what a supplier has to prove before earning a PO.

Now you want a role where your network and your initiative *are* the job. No internal politics, red tape or confused incentives- you plan your time and eat what you kill.

**What You'll Do**

* Become a known face in El Segundo's aerospace community by attending industry events, meetups, conferences, and customer sites, and following up relentlessly.
* Build your own pipeline from your network, AI-driven prospecting tools, and the phone. This is not an inside-sales seat, and there's no inherited book.
* Turn relationships into RFQs. Your core measure is qualified RFQs from new California based customers.
* Partner with BSU engineering and quality to represent our capabilities credibly to technical buyers, from program engineers to supply chain leads.
* Carry opportunities from first conversation through qualification to a quoted, PO-ready RFQ.
* Travel as needed: mostly local face time across SoCal, plus periodic trips to our Austin facility and trade shows. Expand across the west coast over time at your discretion.

**Who You Are**

* Exceptionally proactive. You don't wait for leads to show up. You walk into the room, introduce yourself, and follow up the next morning.
* Technology extrovert. You love meeting new builders and innovators and learning about their products, getting under the hood to understand what they need from their supplier and showing we’ve got it.
* In the game. 2+ years of experience in the space or aerospace industry under your belt. You already have a network in the El Segundo / South Bay aerospace community, and you're excited to keep building it.
* Sales or business development experience is a plus, not a requirement. Show us a track record of initiative, such as an idea you sold, a project you pushed through, or a goal you outworked everyone to hit.
* An engineering degree or technical training is a plus. You’re comfortable having early stage conversations about products, BOMs and build plans before it’s ready to hand over to our quoting team.
* U.S. citizenship required. No exceptions- customers often require this before you can visit their facility.

**Compensation & Ramp**

* Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission, with significant upside tied to hitting RFQ and revenue milestones.

Pay: $100,000.00 - $250,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Are you a U.S. citizen? This is a requirement for this role.
* Do you have at least 2 years of experience working in the space or aerospace industry?
* Do you live in, or within a reasonable commute of, El Segundo, CA?
* Do you currently have professional contacts at aerospace or space companies in the El Segundo / South Bay area?
* Have you been involved in the RFQ or supplier selection process, on either the buying or selling side?

Work Location: Hybrid remote in El Segundo, CA 90245

**Operations Coordinator**

**What We Do**

At Shef, we are bringing weekly personal chef services to busy families in a convenient and affordable format. We believe in providing amateur and professional chefs an opportunity to grow their own meal delivery businesses and make a meaningful income by doing what they love! Every person should have access to a wholesome, home-cooked meal at an affordable price.

We have raised nearly $90M from investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, Craft Ventures, and M13, as well as founders and executives from Instacart, TaskRabbit, StubHub, AngelList, Lyft, Airbnb, and Yelp. We have a ton of exciting work ahead of us and are excited to have you join us!

**Role**

We are looking for an operationally-minded teammate to execute on the day-to-day on-the-ground operations. You will ensure deliveries safely make their way from chefs to consumers and serve as the face of Shef to chefs (“shefs”) in our markets. The ideal candidate is an excellent executor and communicator, and is passionate about bringing delicious, authentic food to their local market!

**Your Responsibilities**

* Ensure clean receipt of deliveries from shefs, and execute on sending deliveries off with third-party logistics providers
* Innovate, test, and measure success of operational efficiency initiatives - create SOPs for initiatives that prove positive enough to become a national standard and help roll-out such initiatives across the country
* Execute on national company standards, set forth by company leadership
* Provide educational and data-driven insights for chefs who visit the hub
* Serve as the face of Shef on the ground, particularly to chefs who drop off at the hub
* Manage hub-level inventory
* Utilize tools including ReTool, Slack, Google Sheets, Zendesk, etc in order to communicate with all stakeholders

**Qualifications:**

* **High sense of responsibility:** you take responsibility for implementing all aspects of operational standards
* **Extreme reliability:** you are on-time, all the time, and you ensure balls do not get dropped
* **Operationally savvy:** you execute, execute, execute. You have a high level of attention to detail, you ensure every delivery goes out on time and in good condition, you maintain food safety rules, etc.
* **Operational strategy:** You identify and reduce operational variances around the hub to streamline operations. You innovate and test, and can measure results of various initiatives you implement on the ground.
* **Communications:** you keep in regular communication with your GM; you know when to escalate and when to keep your GM in the loop so there are no surprises.
* **Problem solving:** when a logistics provider doesn't show up, when an order goes missing -- you can follow SOPs cleanly -- and also come up with a solution if an SOP doesn't exist
* **Coachable on technology & data:** you can learn to manage all tools with minimal error; can debug where necessary (retool, slack, etc). You can learn to read dashboards to understand your performance, and use numbers to make decisions.
* **Seek to serve:** You’re a great representation of Shef’s values towards our chefs. You’re our key person on the ground, and the ultimate host.
* **You’re able to be on your feet for 5 hours a day**

* Hospitality experience
* Customer service experience
* Warehousing, logistics, or other operations experience

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Associate
jobs.description:
### **About Subsense**

Subsense is a deep-tech company developing the world’s first non-surgical, bidirectional brain-computer interface powered by plasmonic and magnetoelectric nanoparticles. Our mission is to unlock direct communication between the human brain and AI - starting with medical applications such as stroke recovery and moving toward cognitive enhancement for healthy users. Headquartered in Palo Alto, Subsense brings together leading scientists and engineers to redefine the future of human–machine interaction.

**About Subsense**

Subsense is building an AI-native NanoBCI: a non-surgical brain-computer interface that uses nanoparticles instead of implants. We are about 40 scientists and engineers across two Bay Area labs, starting with medical applications such as Parkinson's and ALS. Our marketing team runs conferences, PR, investor materials, events and our social presence, and the pace is high.

**The role**

You are the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. In a typical month our marketing team tracks 10 or more conference deadlines, a weekly PR agency cycle, several vendors, lab visits, filming days and investor requests, all at once.

You will own the system that holds all of it: one source of truth for deadlines, owners and status. You will close loops before anyone has to ask. This is a contract-to-hire position based on performance.

### **What you will do**

* **Deadline and task system:** run our marketing task board and calendar, track every deadline, send reminders a week and a day ahead, flag risks early
* **Conferences:** research and shortlist conferences, prepare and submit applications, abstracts and speaker nominations, handle registration, travel and sponsor paperwork (SfN, NYBCI, IEEE Brain, BCI Society, Milken and more)
* **PR agency management:** join the weekly call with PR agency, track action items, check delivered work against the agreed scope, keep invoices on time
* **Scheduling:** book meetings across internal teams, speakers, partners and vendors; prepare agendas and send follow-ups
* **Vendors and paperwork:** route NDAs and contracts, collect quotes, track invoices and expenses, keep files organized in the shared drive
* **Events and visits:** logistics for lab tours, filming days, panels and our annual Forum (speaker travel, catering, venue, RSVPs, thank-you notes, photo delivery)
* **Reporting:** keep a weekly status update for Alex

### **You might be a fit if you**

* Love closing tasks and feel calm when a list is long
* Have 1 to 3 years in operations, events, executive assistance, or agency coordination
* Prioritize well: you can tell what matters today versus what can wait, and you explain why
* Communicate clearly, directly, and think outside the box to find solutions
* Live in Notion, monday.com, Asana or similar, plus Google Workspace, Slack and calendars
* Use AI tools actively to work faster and smarter (summaries, drafts, research) and still check the details
* Live in the Bay Area and can be on-site most days

**Nice to have**

* Experience in biotech, medtech, deep tech or a startup
* Conference or trade show logistics
* Event planning or PR agency background

**How to apply**

Send your resume and a short note on the most complex thing you have kept organized. Shortlisted candidates complete three short test tasks and present them in a Loom before the first interview.

### **Why You’ll Thrive**

You'd be joining a small team developing a non-surgical, bidirectional brain-computer interface powered by plasmonic and magnetoelectric nanoparticles. You’ll help translate early research into working technology, with the opportunity to influence both the platform and how we build it.

**A few things that make this different:**

* **Own meaningful technical work:** Take projects from early R&D through functional prototypes, with room to test ideas, solve complex problems, and shape design decisions.
* **Build across disciplines:** Work hands-on with ultrasound, electronics, and instrumentation alongside scientists and engineers in neuroscience, nanotechnology, and AI.
* **Help shape a novel platform:** Contribute to technology with the potential to restore neurological function and, over time, enable direct brain-to-AI communication.
* **Make a visible impact:** Join a team where your contributions directly influence technical progress, with equity that lets you share in the company’s growth.

Our work takes place across labs in Palo Alto and Mountain View. We offer a competitive salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k), commuter benefits, and paid time off.

*Subsense is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

We are seeking an experienced Account Manager to drive sales of advanced fluidics solutions (valves, manifolds, flow sensors, hoses, fittings, weldments, chemical delivery modules, liquid leak detection) to key accounts in the semiconductor industry.

jobs.title: Account Manager, SME & Growth
jobs.description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

**About the team**
------------------

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales. It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward. If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

**What you'll do**
------------------

Airwallex is looking for an Account Manager to manage and grow a substantial portfolio of US-based small and medium customers. You will build trusted relationships with founders, CFOs, CEOs, and other senior stakeholders while helping customers maximize the value of Airwallex's global financial platform.

You will use customer insight, product knowledge, and account data to increase product adoption, identify expansion opportunities, and support smooth ongoing operations. This role combines consultative account management, revenue growth, customer advocacy, and cross-functional problem solving across a diverse portfolio of approximately 200 accounts.

We are a hybrid working environment with 3 days per week in the office (SF, NYC).

### **Responsibilities:**

* Identify and convert upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts by using customer feedback, usage data, and account signals to prioritize the highest-impact opportunities.
* Manage a diverse book of approximately 200 US-based accounts, including businesses that operate across multiple countries, and develop a clear understanding of each customer's goals, operating model, and financial workflows.
* Serve as the go-to expert on the Airwallex platform, helping customers maximize the value of core products and adopt additional solutions such as FX, Cards, Online Payments, and other relevant products.
* Build lasting relationships with CFOs, CEOs, founders, and other key decision makers through consultative conversations, regular business reviews, and ongoing engagement focused on customer outcomes.
* Partner with Account Executives, Customer Success, Strategy and Operations, Marketing, Product, Risk, Support, and other internal teams to resolve customer challenges, improve the client experience, and maximize platform utilization.
* Act as the voice of the customer internally by communicating emerging needs, product feedback, operational issues, and opportunities to improve Airwallex's products and processes.

**Who you are**
---------------

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* 4+ years of account management or software sales experience in technology, SaaS, fintech, payments, or a related industry.
* Strong sales skills, including value-based solution selling, commercial judgment, and the ability to navigate complex sales cycles.
* Demonstrated success managing a substantial book of business and driving revenue growth through account expansion, upselling, cross-selling, or product adoption.
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to build trust and present effectively to CFOs, CEOs, and other senior stakeholders.
* Experience using Salesforce or another CRM, together with spreadsheets, dashboards, or similar tools to organize account data, prioritize opportunities, and manage customer activity.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, API sales, or other technology serving merchants and internationally operating businesses.
* Experience acting as a strategic payments or financial technology advisor, using data and customer insight to explain business value and influence customer decisions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an organized and methodical approach to managing a high-volume portfolio.
* Proven ability to work with ownership, curiosity, and a customer-first mindset in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, including the ability to figure things out and collaborate across functions.

**Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters**
-------------------------------------------------------------

*To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official

Whether you're early in your career or a seasoned sales professional, join today and earn a competitive lucrative salary, which includes base pay and target individual-based commission. jobs.title: Associate Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

**Overview:**

Are you passionate about blending business consulting with advanced analytics? We’re seeking a Senior Value Engineer to join our FinOps & Spend Analytics team at Snowflake. You’ll collaborate with account teams and engage directly with customers to optimize their use of Snowflake’s cloud platform.

The ideal candidate brings:

* **Analytical Skills**: Proficiency in Excel, SQL, and Python to deliver actionable insights.
* **Technical Architecture Understanding**: Familiarity with cloud-based systems, ideally Snowflake, to understand and communicate technical aspects in addition to financial optimizations.
* **Consulting or Sales Experience**: Background in financial planning and analysis (FP&A), business/IT consulting, or consultative sales to engage and drive customer value.

Experience in FP&A and business consulting paired with strong analytical and technical skills, will be key to success in this role.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Consultative Engagements**: Partner with account teams and customers to frame and address complex business challenges through data-driven insights, focusing on cost optimization, performance enhancement, and ROI maximization.
* **Advanced Data Analysis:** Analyze customer consumption data on Snowflake to provide actionable insights that attribute, control, and optimize spend across various business units, workloads, and use cases.
* **Cloud Economics & FinOps**: Develop and refine cloud unit economics models, define KPIs, and support cost, usage, and performance benchmarks tailored to specific customer needs.
* **Strategic ROI Modeling:** Build and maintain sophisticated ROI and economic models to support customer budgeting, forecasting, and the rollout of new Snowflake features.
* **Data Storytelling:** Translate complex data insights into compelling narratives that influence strategic decisions, catering to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Qualifications:**

* **Education**: A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, such as Computer Science, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline. Advanced degrees or certifications in analytics or business management (e.g., MBA) are advantageous.
* **Work Experience:** 6-10 years of relevant working experience, including 4+ years focused in data analytics, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), business consulting, or cloud data warehousing.
* **Business Consulting/FP&A Expertise**: A strong background in business consulting or FP&A, with a proven ability to solve complex business problems using data and analytics.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Advanced skills in SQL and Excel for data analysis and reporting – familiarity with Python and Snowflake or other cloud-based data platforms will be an advantage.
* **Cloud Technology Acumen**: A solid understanding of cloud technology architectures, particularly in data warehousing, and experience in cloud economics or FinOps will be a plus.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

* This role is eligible to participate in Snowflake's commission plan and it is common for employees in this role to receive total on-target earnings of $222,700 - $292,320. The estimated base salary for this role is $167,025 - $219,240.
* Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s equity plan.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending & health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits.

To comply with pay transparency requirements and other statutes, you can notify us if you believe that a job posting is not compliant by completing this form.

JAM Services is a leading distributor of traffic lighting, highway safety and traffic control products and underground equipment serving state DOTs, municipalities, highway contractors, and traffic control companies throughout California.

* Provide consultative solutions aligned with customer needs and project specifications

* Develop comprehensive knowledge of JAM Services product portfolio

* Customer-centric, consultative selling approach
* Strong presentation and communication skills
* High level of organization and time management
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and collaboratively

jobs.title: Social Media Manager (Part-time)
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**  
Club Athletic is a premium members' training club with locations across New York City, Chicago and Hoboken. Our members train in squads: small, consistent groups that show up for each other. We're growing fast, and our social channels are where people first meet the club.

**About the Role**  
You'll run our Instagram and TikTok day to day, so they feel alive, consistent and true to the club. Our Director of Marketing sets the monthly editorial calendar. Our in-house content producer, coaches and members supply the photos and video. Your job is to turn that into a steady, on-brand presence and a community that feels looked after.

Military experience* -We recognize and appreciate the unique talents and experiences Veterans bring to the table. We value the discipline, commitment, and problem-solving abilities you have developed and are excited to provide an environment where you can continue to make a meaningful impact.

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
JAM Services is a leading distributor of traffic lighting, highway safety and traffic control products and underground equipment serving state DOTs, municipalities, highway contractors, and traffic control companies throughout California.

The Outside Sales Representative is responsible for generating new business, expanding existing customer relationships, and promoting JAM’s products and services in the San Francisco Bay area. This position focuses on proactive project development, face-to-face customer engagement, and technical sales support. Success in this role requires a combination of industry knowledge, strong communication skills, and the ability to identify solutions that align with customer needs.

Requirements

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Revenue Growth & Business Development**

* Drive sales growth and consistently exceed established revenue goals
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities across assigned territory
* Expand market share within targeted product categories

**Strategic Account Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and decision-makers
* Develop long-term partnerships with state, county, and municipal agencies
* Provide consultative solutions aligned with customer needs and project specifications

**Product & Market Expertise**

* Develop comprehensive knowledge of JAM Services product portfolio
* Learn and interpret state, county, and municipal specifications and codes
* Conduct product demonstrations and presentations to showcase solutions
* Collaborate with vendors to align product capabilities with customer requirements

**Collaboration & Reporting**

* Partner with leadership and the broader sales team to execute growth strategies
* Maintain accurate CRM documentation of sales activities and pipeline progress
* Participate in trade shows, marketing initiatives, and training programs

**Other Duties**

* Conduct daily business in compliance with company policies and departmental guidelines.
* Perform other tasks and special projects as assigned.

**Qualifications**

**Education & Experience**

* Minimum **5+ years of B2B sales experience**, preferably within construction, manufacturing, or infrastructure-related industries
* Experience in traffic safety or roadway products is strongly preferred
* Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) preferred

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Customer-centric, consultative selling approach
* Strong presentation and communication skills
* High level of organization and time management
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and collaboratively
* Proficient in CRM systems and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Professional presence and strong interpersonal skills
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory and occasionally outside of the territory for events such as trade shows or visiting manufacturer’s facilities. Some overnight travel is required.

**Physical Demands and Work Environment:**

The physical demands described below are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, and walk, and to talk or hear; the role also requires the use of hands to finger, handle, or touch objects and controls. The employee must be able to remain in a stationary position for extended periods while driving, attending meetings, or working at a computer, as well as move about client sites, trade shows, and event venues, which may involve standing and walking for extended periods. On occasion, the employee may be required to stoop, bend, kneel, reach above the shoulders, or otherwise position materials when setting up displays or retrieving items.

The employee must occasionally lift, transport, and position items up to 25–50 pounds, such as product samples, marketing materials, or demonstration equipment, with or without assistance. Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

This role also requires the ability to travel frequently within the assigned territory, which may include driving or other modes of transportation.

Work is performed in a variety of settings, including client offices, event venues, trade show floors, vehicles, and occasional outdoor locations.

Exposure to varying noise levels and environmental conditions may occur depending on client sites and travel requirements.

Salary Description

$70K plus commission

**About Us**

Revenue Vessel is a growing, venture backed software company on a mission to revolutionize how logistics companies sell. We've built a product that our customers love, and are looking for help to grow significantly over the next 12 months. Our cold outreach motion is really working and we have already promoted, or will promote, all of our SDRs that we have hired. We need to hire the next generation of account executives and account managers, which starts with the SDR position.

Revenue Vessel is building out a new sales solution for logistics and has ambitions to be the key sales operating system across the industry. Our solution helps our customers better target and reach out to prospects that fit their services. We view our SDRs as future leaders, especially because they understand the challenges that our customers face when reaching out to prospects for new business.

Despite being less than three years old, we have signed annual contracts with fifteen out of the top twenty-five freight forwarders in our space and are looking to rapidly expand adoption and product surface area within our key accounts.

The three co-founders have strong backgrounds in the space: former Head of Demand Gen at Flexport, former top-performing sales leader at Flexport, former Head of Eng at Rutter API, respectively. Revenue Vessel is a solution built off the pain points and solutions the founders solved at Flexport.

Both our CEO and COO were former SDR leaders and are experienced in building the systems and career pathing that is required. jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Project Coordinator

Swoon Spaces · Luxury Home Organization and Home Concierge

Location: New York City and New Jersey

Type: Freelance, booked by the session

Pay: $22 to $28 per hour, based on experience

Bringing you from chaos to calm.

Love a beautifully styled shelf, a perfectly folded stack and a closet that finally makes sense? Join Swoon Spaces as a Project Coordinator and help bring calm to beautiful homes, one session at a time. No organizing experience needed. We train you.

About Swoon Spaces

Swoon Spaces is a luxury home organization and home concierge company with teams in New York City and New Jersey, Los Angeles and Austin. We step into our clients' closets, kitchens, pantries, nurseries and every space in between, and leave behind calm, beauty and systems that last. Every session is guided by a lead organizer and supported by a small, close team.

The Role

As a Project Coordinator, you support the lead organizer, the client and the team so every session moves the project forward. You help contain the chaos, protect the client experience and keep the work moving from arrival through closeout.

What You'll Do

In the home

- Empty drawers, shelves, cabinets and closets, then sort like with like into clear categories.

- Keep categories clearly separated (keep, donate, trash, return and relocate), labeling temporary piles with sticky notes.

- Fold, switch out hangers and color code under the lead's direction.

- Unpack and prepare product, then place items and create labels once the lead approves the system.

- Wipe surfaces before items go back, then reset the space for photos and the client walkthrough.

Behind the scenes

- Pick up product orders from The Container Store and other approved stores.

- Return unused product and drop off donations at approved locations.

With the team

- Follow the lead's plan, and bring questions about product, scope, timing or client decisions to the lead.

- Look for the next useful task the moment one is complete.

- Represent Swoon with warmth, discretion and polish in every home.

Who You Are

- Design minded. Inspired by aesthetics and the feeling of a beautifully finished space.

- Detail oriented. You notice the label a hair off center and the hanger facing the wrong way.

- Fast and focused through a full day of hands on work.

- Ready for physical work: long days on your feet, lifting boxes, using ladders and working in tight closets.

- Warm and discreet with clients, including in their most private spaces.

- Able to read the room, aware of tone, body language and client energy.

- Coachable, welcoming feedback with a calm, positive attitude.

- Reliable: on time, prepared and polished, and quick to communicate when plans change.

- Comfortable using Google Workspace (Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Docs and Google Sheets) and your smartphone.

Experience in organizing, interior design, styling, home staging, visual merchandising, move management, hospitality or luxury retail is a lovely bonus, but never a requirement.

Schedule

- Freelance and booked by the session, so you choose the sessions that fit your week.

- Most sessions are 6 to 8 hours long.

- Paid hourly for the sessions you book.

How to Apply

Email careers@swoonspaces.com with the subject line "Project Coordinator: NYC/NJ" and include:

- A short note on why organizing makes your heart happy.

- Your resume or a summary of your experience.

- Your general availability.

- A few photos of spaces you have organized or styled, if you have them.

Questions are always welcome at the same address.

Swoon Spaces welcomes applicants of every background and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by law.

Pay: $22.00 - $28.00 per hour

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Work Location: In person

The Andrew Carnegie Foundation, originally established as Carnegie Corporation of New York, was founded in 1911 by Andrew Carnegie. Today, our funding supports the issues that Carnegie considered most important: education, democracy, and peace.

Our grantmaking is grounded in Andrew Carnegie’s vision to do “real and permanent good in the world.”

**About the International Program:**

The International Program is rooted in Andrew Carnegie’s founding vision - to advance peace as both the absence of armed conflict and the creation of conditions that sustain nonviolent growth and change. In an era of multidimensional crises - ranging from wars and migration pressures to disruptive technologies. The program seeks to catalyze peace through integrated, evidence-based approaches that bridge knowledge and action.

**Position Summary:**

The Operations Coordinator will report to and provide administrative support to the Vice President and coordinate all international program department-wide activities. The ideal candidate will be proactive, curious, detail oriented, and possess knowledge of, or interest in international affairs.

**Responsibilities:**

* Assist the vice president in departmental management, planning and communication.

* Excellentorganizational and interpersonal skills.
