jobs.title: PL Underwriting Sales Representative
jobs.description:
If you have a proven track record of consistently exceeding annual new sales & revenue retention goals, have experience in consultative sales, and excel at building long-lasting and trusting relationships with your customer base, we want to talk to you!

Our Verisk Underwriting Sales Team is seeking a driven and entrepreneurially minded Account Executive to be the lead in identifying, managing, and closing sales opportunities within an assigned U.S. account territory that covers accounts that range from established insurers to emerging InsurTechs or established producers including brokerages, MGA’s and agencies.

This is a remote position that would involve working from home and traveling to customer locations. Occasionally, travel to our main office located in Jersey City, NJ is required.

  

* Driven seller who thrives working in a team selling environment with Product Managers, Subject Matter Experts, Business Development Representatives, Executives, and others to ensure that our complex solutions fit within our customers’ workflows
* Strategic thinker who possesses a structured approach to selling that includes strong prospecting skills and the ability to sell based on business value
* Able to quickly gain knowledge of your customers’ business and consultatively articulate Verisk’s value proposition across different operations within their organization
* Able to quickly understand the customer decision-making process and influence key decision makers
* Accountability to the Verisk sales process
* Relentless in qualifying deals
* Problem solver
* Exceed average annual new sales goals of $3.5M-6M
* Flawlessly manage deals with an average new total contract value (TCV) of $135,000 with an average sales cycle of 7 months
* Manage existing solution revenue from current customer base within an assigned territory of 6 to 25 accounts for both growth and retention
* Prospect across the whole account and build a solid pipeline (2.5 to 3X sales goal) within assigned sales territory
* Successfully manage a short, mid and long-term strategic sales plan to attain a deep understanding and trust within assigned sales territory
* Actively maintain and communicate sales territory activity, notes, updates, call reports and opportunities with sales peers, sales leadership and product management as well as within Salesforce.com
* Develop customized solution proposals and contractual agreements
* Coordinate and work closely on sales opportunities, where required, with other Verisk Team members
* Provide timely feedback to sales peers, sales leadership, product management and marketing on developing industry trends, new product ideas and competitive intelligence within assigned sales territory
* Facilitate and develop trusting relationships on all levels within assigned sales territory accounts.

**What Account Executives Love About Working Here:**

* On Target Earnings (OTE) structed comp plan with significant earning potential
* Paid Parental Leave
* Paid Time Off starting at 24 days annually
* Short- and Long-Term Disability Leave available as needed
* Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision Plans
* 401K Savings Plan
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Life Insurance
* Employee Assistance Plan
* Wellness Program
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending

  

* Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university
* Professional Training Program experience a plus
* Proficiency in MS Office and Salesforce.com
* Coachable self-starter with the ability to work from a remote home office effectively
* Ability to travel up to 50% of the time
* Good to have: solid understanding and experience of Property Casualty Insurance; working knowledge of insurance functions, especially Underwriting, Marketing, Product Development, Actuarial, Modeling is a plus, as is knowledge across property and casualty
* Good to have: three years’ experience and successful track record within a complex sales environment
* Good to have: proven successful sales history in insurance software, data, geospatial and/or predictive modeling software solutions a plus
* Good to have: experience facilitating contract processes
* Good to have: Salesforce.com experience and comfortability adopting new tools

#LI-MB1

#LI-Remote

  

For over 50 years, Verisk has been the leading data analytics and technology partner to the global insurance industry by delivering value to our clients through expertise and scale. We empower communities and businesses to make better decisions on risk, faster.

At Verisk, you'll have the chance to use your voice and build a rewarding career that's as unique as you are, with work flexibility and the support, coaching, and training you need to succeed.

For the eighth consecutive year, Verisk is proudly recognized as a Great Place to Work® for outstanding workplace culture in the US, the fourth consecutive year in the UK, Spain, and India, and the second consecutive year in Poland. In addition, we’ve been recognized by The Wall Street Journal as one of the Best-Managed Companies and by Forbes as a World’s Best Employer, testaments to the value we place on workplace culture.

We’re 7,000 people strong. We relentlessly and ethically pursue innovation. And we are looking for people like you to help us translate big data into big ideas. Join us and create an exceptional experience for yourself and a better tomorrow for future generations.

**Verisk Businesses**

Underwriting Solutions — provides underwriting and rating solutions for auto and property, general liability, and excess and surplus to assess and price risk with speed and precision

Claims Solutions — supports end-to-end claims handling with analytic and automation tools that streamline workflow, improve claims management, and support better customer experiences

Property and Restoration Solutions — offers property estimation software and tools for professionals in estimating all phases of building and repair to make day-to-day workflows the most efficient

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative - North Jersey
jobs.description:
**Position Purpose:**

The Outside Sales Representative (OSR) is responsible for driving incremental sales growth and profitability through account relationships, specifically focusing on Complex Business Expansion and new business development. The OSR will monitor key performance indicators for assigned professional customers and meet or exceed Sales and Margin performance to plan by working with the Pro Sales Manager. OSRs leverage data, customer insights, and review pertinent Pro customer satisfaction results to understand customers' perspectives and use the information to drive local decisions and strategies to improve competitive position and drive capability adoption.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* 10% - Cross-Functional Collaboration - Participate in district/regional meetings as needed. Communicate weekly activities with Pro Sales Manager.
* 60% - Cultivate Net New Sales Relationships - Utilize local community events to continuously represent The Home Depot Pro brand and drive new business and grow Complex Business expansion. Sell all products and services available from the enterprise, including Commercial Credit options, Volume Pricing Program, delivery, will call pickup, and website ordering. Produce new account revenue in line with current organization through individual targets/quotas. Partner with Inside Sales Support Representative as a daily point of contact to drive an end-to-end quoting, ordering, and transaction experience for customers. Establish effective partnerships with assigned customers by completing in-person sales appointments. Develop strategies focused on expanding customer base within defined sales territory. Drive incremental sales growth by cultivating business relationships with assigned customer portfolios and prospecting to drive incremental sales growth.
* 10% - Customer Relationship Management - Utilize Salesforce to plan future sales call activity, manage ongoing customer communications, and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
* 20% - Sales Prospecting - Conduct initial customer meetings and build relationships, selling The Home Depot value proposition and win opportunity to quote materials. Prospect for new business leveraging leads provided by internal Sales Development team as well as leads generated in the field via existing customer relationships, stores, and within the community.

**Direct Manager/Direct Reports:**

* This Position typically reports to the Pro Sales Manager
* This Has 0 Direct Reports

**Travel Requirements:**

* Typically requires overnight travel 20% to 50% of the time.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Most of the time is spent sitting in the same position or standing/walking or there is some requirement to lift or handle material or equipment of moderate weight (8-20 pounds).

**Working Conditions:**

* Typically in a comfortable environment but with regular exposure to factors such as temperature extremes, moving machinery, loud noise, and fumes that cause noticeable discomfort or a moderate risk of accident or illness.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Must be 18 years of age or older
* Must be legally permitted to work in the United States

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite
* 5 years of professional work experience
* 2 years account management/sales management experience
* 2 plus years home improvement or home building industry experience
* Successful professional growth in a high-paced retail environment
* Demonstrates a strong ability to create and cultivate an active network of relationships both inside and outside the organization
* Ability to leverage relationships to accomplish sales and profitability goals
* Deep understanding of Pro customer needs with a focus on fulfilling 100% of their product, credit, and performance requirements
* Determine how each customer would prefer to be served and tailor communications and customer-facing activities appropriately
* Strong leadership and negotiation skills; ability to persuade or influence others
* Excellent communication skills (verbal, written) and able to communicate globally

**Minimum Education:**

* The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a high school diploma and/or GED.

**Preferred Education:**

No additional education  



**Minimum Years of Work Experience:**

* 2

**Preferred Years of Work Experience:**

* 5

**Minimum Leadership Experience:**

* No previous leadership experience

**Preferred Leadership Experience:**

* No previous leadership experience

**Certifications:**

* None

**Competencies:**

* Action Oriented
* Being Resilient
* Persuades
* Builds Networks
* Communicates Effectively
* Customer Focus
* Drives Results

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
The Inside Sales Representative (ISR) is a key member of Fortinet’s sales organization, responsible for driving growth within an assigned territory. In this role, you will partner closely with Field and Inside Sales Account Managers to build and execute strategies that expand new customer acquisition while strengthening existing relationships.

At Fortinet, we foster a results driven, high performance culture that rewards hard work, innovation, and excellence. Our team thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where initiative is encouraged and success is celebrated. Fortinet invests heavily in its people providing comprehensive onboarding, continuous technical and sales training, and ongoing enablement to ensure your long-term success.

As an ISR, you will collaborate with Fortinet’s reseller partners, marketing teams, and channel organizations to drive opportunities, generate pipeline, and increase revenue. You will play a pivotal role at the forefront of identifying new business opportunities and contributing to the overall success of the sales organization.

This role offers clear career advancement opportunities, empowering team members to grow within the sales organization, and recognizing top performers with career development, rewards, and increased responsibility.

Job Responsibilities

* Generate new sales opportunities through outbound calls, emails, and social media outreach

* Qualify leads and set appointments for the sales team, ensuring a steady flow of high-quality meetings and opportunities

* Create and track sales opportunities (leads, renewals, and deal registrations in Salesforce.com)

* Manage small-scale deals and renewal opportunities throughout the full sales cycle, from pre‑sale to post‑sale.

* Collaborate with sales team to strategize outreach and lead qualifications.

* Address customer satisfaction issues and requests in a timely manner and assist with customer presentations and demos

* Meet and exceed sales activity metrics designed to drive productivity and success

* Align with sales, channel, and partner teams to support overall company revenue targets

* Execute the role with professionalism and in alignment with Fortinet’s core values

* Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship

Required Qualifications

* Prior experience as an Inside Sales Representative (ISR), Business Development Representative (BDR), or in a similar sales role

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

* Strong communicator with proven relationship-building skills

* Self-starter: coachable, adaptable, and growth-driven

* Proficient with Salesforce and modern prospecting tools

* Highly organized, resilient, and results-focused

* Entrepreneurial mindset with forward-thinking problem-solving

Preferred Qualifications

* Technical degree in Computer Science, Information Technology/Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field

* Background in networking, security, and/or public/private cloud (preferred)

* 1–3 years of sales or related individual contributor experience

* Experience with multi-tier distribution (Channel Sales)

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time as well as a comprehensive leave program.

Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, and job level. On target earnings for this position is expected to be $70,000 - $85,000 per year. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.

All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program, and this position is also eligible for commissions based on the terms of the Sales Compensation Plan

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Business Development Representative — AI Infrastructure**

**Location:** On-site in the NYC metro or San Francisco Bay Area  
**Base:** $60,000–$77,000 | **OTE:** $85,000–$110,000  
**Full-time | Confidential search**

jobs.description:
About the Role

The Project Coordinator supports the execution of customer orders and entry-level projects for an industrial manufacturer of motors and drives. This role serves as a key coordination point between customers, Sales, Application Engineering, Project Management, manufacturing facilities, and other stakeholders to ensure technical and commercial requirements, documentation, schedules, and deliverables are completed accurately and on time. The ideal candidate is highly organized, customer-focused, and enjoys managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Primary Responsibilities

* Coordinate customer orders and entry-level projects from order handoff through completion using established processes, schedules, and project requirements.
* Serve as a day-to-day coordination point among customers, Sales, Application Engineering, Project Management, manufacturing facilities, and other stakeholders.
* Provide customers and stakeholders with accurate technical, commercial, order status, and project documentation within established guidelines.
* Review customer purchase orders and related documentation for completeness; identify discrepancies and coordinate resolution with the appropriate resource.
* Maintain project and order information in applicable ERP, CRM, and project tracking systems.
* Track order and project milestones, documentation requirements, approvals, manufacturing dates, shipment dates, and other deliverables; communicate status and escalate risks or delays as needed.
* Coordinate technical document submissions, approvals, and customer documentation requirements with Engineering, manufacturing facilities, Sales, and Project Management.
* Support order changes, schedule updates, shipping coordination, and other project administration activities in accordance with established procedures.
* Prepare customer communications, project status reports, meeting notes, action-item logs, and other project documentation.
* Respond to customer and internal inquiries, research issues, and route technical, commercial, contractual, or schedule matters to the appropriate resource as needed.
* Support customer satisfaction through timely communication, accurate records, and consistent follow-through on assigned actions.
* Participate in project handoff, status, and coordination meetings as assigned.
* Follow applicable quality, safety, compliance, records management, and company procedures.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Education

* High School Diploma or GED; Required
* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering Technology, Supply Chain, Project Management, or a related field; Preferred

Experience & Knowledge

* 0-1 year of experience in project coordination, sales support, order management, customer service, manufacturing, or a related environment
* Basic understanding of project coordination, order management, and customer service principles
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Outlook, Word, and Teams
* Ability to learn ERP, CRM, order management, and project tracking systems
* Basic ability to read, organize, and manage technical and commercial information related to industrial products and customer orders
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and follow-through
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Ability to prioritize multiple assignments, follow established procedures, and escalate issues appropriately
* Ability to work effectively across Sales, Engineering, Project Management, Manufacturing, and customer-facing teams in a deadline-driven environment

Travel Requirements

* Occasional travel based on business needs. Travel may include visits to company facilities, customer sites, or project locations.

About WEG Electric Corp.

WEG Electric Corp. is the largest industrial electric motor manufacturer in the Americas and one of the largest electric motor manufacturers in the world, producing more than 21 million units annually. Founded in 1961, WEG Electric Corp. operates mainly in the sector of capital goods, having five main businesses: Motors, Energy, Automation, Coatings, Transmission & Distribution, providing global solutions for electric motors, variable frequency drives, soft starters, controls,

panels, transformers, and generators. The US corporate office is in Duluth, GA, with manufacturing units in Minnesota, Indiana, and Missouri, and over 30,000 employees worldwide. Visit our website to learn more: www.weg.net

We offer a pleasant work environment, competitive compensation, and a full benefits package. To Apply: All candidates must submit an updated resume and complete our application in order to be considered for this position. Must be authorized to work in the United States. WEG Electric Corp. does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

jobs.title: Studio Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job ID:** 18560

**Alternate Locations:**

**Newell Brands** is a leading consumer products company with a portfolio of iconic brands like Graco®, Coleman®, Oster®, Rubbermaid®, Sharpie® and Yankee Candle® - and 24,000 talented teammates around the world. Our culture is built on values in action: Integrity, Teamwork, Passion for Winning, Ownership, and Leadership. We work together to win, grow, and make a real impact—supported by a high-performing, inclusive, and collaborative environment where you can be your best, every day.

  

**Location:** Atlanta, Georgia (Morgan Falls Studo)

**Summary:**

The Studio Operations Coordinator supports the daily operations, front desk experience, and administrative coordination of the Atlanta Design Center and Morgan Falls Creative Studio. This role will include a portion of hybrid support across both Studio and Design Center needs; with location support shared between Morgan Falls Studio and the Queen building. Over time, the role is expected to transition into a more dedicated Studio support function with key partnerships across both locations.

Acting as a key first point of contact, this individual helps create a welcoming, organized, and production-ready environment for internal teams, business partners, visitors, talent, crew, vendors, and external partners. The role supports front desk management, visitor systems, studio facilities coordination, sample movement, supplies, scheduling support, and day-to-day operational needs that help the Studio and Design Center run smoothly.

This role requires strong organization, proactive problem solving, a hospitality mindset, and the ability to support a fast-moving creative environment. The ideal candidate is service-minded, detail-oriented, flexible across locations, and able to anticipate needs while maintaining a professional and efficient workplace experience.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Studio Operations Coordinator will support day-to-day Design Center and Creative Studio operations, including:

* Serve as front desk and daily operations support for the Morgan Falls Creative Studio.
* Manage the visitor experience and visitor management system, including check-in, badges, arrivals, guest coordination, and communication with hosts.
* Coordinate talent, crew, vendor, and partner arrivals for studio production days in partnership with Studio Manager and producers.
* Provide location support across the Queen building and Morgan Falls Studio, maintaining flexibility to travel between sites as business and Studio needs require.
* Partner with Studio leadership, Design Operations, Office Services, Facilities, IT, and other support teams to remove operational friction and keep daily work moving.
* Coordinate routine and reactive facilities needs, including maintenance requests, cleanliness, room readiness, access needs, signage, repairs, and building support.
* Help maintain conference rooms, talent holding areas, work lounges, office areas, front desk spaces, and shared Studio support spaces so they are organized and ready for use.
* Support production days through sample coordination, product and prop movement, supply readiness, talent and crew arrival support, and basic production logistics.
* Track, order, and organize office, Studio, production, and usability supplies to ensure teams have the materials needed to work effectively.
* Support sample receipt, movement, storage, handoff, and general coordination across Studio and Design Center needs.
* Coordinate FedEx, UPS, courier, and internal shipments, including incoming and outgoing materials as needed.
* Assist with Studio and Design Center meetings, creative reviews, visitor sessions, catering, hospitality, room setup, and space readiness.
* Support internal communications, distribution lists, announcements, and basic administrative coordination as needed.
* Help document repeatable processes for visitor management, sample coordination, supply requests, front desk coverage, and Studio support routines.
* As Morgan Falls Studio scales, transition toward more dedicated Studio support with stronger focus on front desk management, production readiness, facilities support, and day-to-day Studio operations.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Key Qualifications:**

* High school degree required plus additional broad specialized training equivalent to 2 years of college. Bachelor's degree preferred.
* 2+ years of experience in front desk coordination, office coordination, studio coordination, administrative support, hospitality, workplace operations, or related support role.
* Experience supporting a creative, production, design, corporate, or fast-paced office environment preferred.
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to welcome visitors, coordinate with partners, and proactively share updates or issues.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail, time management, follow-through, and ability to manage multiple daily priorities.
* Experience with visitor management systems, scheduling, supply ordering, shipping and receiving, facilities tickets, purchase requests, or workplace support tools preferred.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office 365, including Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Ability to work with multiple stakeholders, including Studio, Design, Office Services, Facilities, IT, vendors, talent, crew, and external guests.
* Service-minded with a strong hospitality approach and commitment to creating a welcoming, organized, and professional workplace experience.
* Comfortable supporting multiple locations and shifting between Design Center and Studio needs during the transition period.
* Experience with SAP, procurement, or Newell Brands-specific processes and tools preferred.
* Ability to periodically travel between local sites and locations.
* Ability to lift, move, or coordinate light supplies, samples, and materials as needed.
* Ability to learn Newell Brands-specific processes, tools, and operation

About SpendHQ  
  
SpendHQ is a fast-growing and dynamic Procuretech Scale-up with an incredible collaborative company culture. Our team is constantly innovating – we invented performance management for procurement and we are a market leader and innovator in spend analytics. We provide procurement teams with the tools they need to drive value for their organization, and we have fun doing it.  
  
The SpendHQ SaaS solution has been on the market for over 10 years. Our clients are recognized market leaders from both mid-size organizations and large, multinational corporations. There are 20,000+ SpendHQ users across 500+ global clients.  
  
It is thanks to each of our employees that we are where we are today. We proudly have more over 100 team members in 10 countries with headquarters in both Atlanta and Lyon. But we are not stopping here. SpendHQ is taking on new challenges and we look forward to continuing to grow the company and team.  
  
  
**Where would you fit in the team?**  
  
The Strategic Account Manager role focuses on strengthening relationships with key accounts, driving value through SpendHQ’s solutions. It involves collaborating with senior stakeholders to develop long-term strategies, driving revenue growth, ensuring client retention, and managing complex sales processes. The role also influences product strategy to meet client needs.  
  
**What will your job entail?**

* Manage and strengthen relationships with strategic accounts, aligning SpendHQ solutions with client objectives.
* Identify and capitalize on growth opportunities like cross-selling and up-selling to achieve revenue goals.
* Develop strategic account plans to reach long-term revenue targets.
* Identify risks early and build a strong plan to retain customers.
* Educate and guide complex clients on best practices for SpendHQ’s solutions.
* Assist clients in creating ROI cases and executing procurement strategies tailored to their organizational goals.
* Lead high-stakes sales cycles and renewal negotiations, ensuring client buy-in.

**What experience and skills do you need to succeed?**

* You have at least 5 to 10 years of experience in an Account Management or Sales role within an Enterprise SaaS environment.
* You are familiar with the procurement technology landscape and understand the industry.
* You have a strong business mindset and enjoy negotiating and identifying opportunities.
* You are organized, rigorous, and detail-oriented.
* You are proactive and autonomous, and comfortable taking ownership of client relationships.
* You have excellent verbal communication skills and the ability to build strong relationships with prospects and clients.
* You are able to quickly learn and use tools such as CRM platforms.
* You are a team player who enjoys helping colleagues and collaborating across teams.
* You are fluent in English, both written and spoken, which is the primary working language.

**Why do people love working at SpendHQ?**  
  
At SpendHQ, we are:

* Stronger Together – Everyone plays an important role at SpendHQ. We deliver more success through shared goals and mutual support. We work diligently to break down silos and collaborate.
* People Focused – We care about those we work with and those we serve. We strive for strong results, but not at the expense of people.

* Customer Obsessed – Our customers are the reason for our success. We work hard to provide solutions that make their lives easier and help them achieve extraordinary things.
* Bold in Action – We believe in taking daring moves. We do everything with enthusiasm because we know our work is meaningful.

**What you need to know?**  
  
Salary commensurate with experience. This is a full-time, salaried position with a competitive benefits package:

* Parental leave
* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Performance bonus
* Remote work policy

* Equity Program

The position is based in our US Headquarter in Atlanta and reports to our US Account Management Team Lead.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, disability, age, or any other protected status. If you don’t meet every requirement but believe you would be a great fit, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.description:
**About Alpine**

Pioneers in our industry, we have built our reputation on providing intelligent and energy-efficient HVAC solutions to homeowners. At Alpine, we're proud to maintain an exceptional customer satisfaction rating of 4.85 (out of 5), a testament to our unwavering commitment to delivering excellence.

**About the Role**

We are hiring **Call Center Project Coordinators** (PCs) to serve as the frontline owners of customer intake and early-stage experience.

In this role, you will guide customers through their first interactions with Alpine, helping them move toward the right next step with clarity and minimal friction. You’ll partner with internal tools (including AI-assisted workflows) and SOPs to understand customer needs, remove simple blockers when appropriate, and create clean, accurate handoffs to the right teams.

This role blends real-time customer experience with operational thinking. You’ll shape how customers experience Alpine while also contributing to how our systems and processes improve over time.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys helping people in live interactions, thinking critically about how work flows, and improving processes through thoughtful execution.

**What You Will Do**

* Serve as the first point of contact for customers across phone and chat
* Guide customers toward the right next step in their journey with minimal friction
* Ask thoughtful, targeted questions to clarify goals, constraints, and missing information
* Resolve simple issues when appropriate to reduce unnecessary transfers
* Apply SOPs and workflow logic while adapting to real-world customer scenarios
* Use AI-assisted intake and routing tools as decision support, applying judgment to ensure quality
* Set customers and downstream teams up for success through clear documentation and accurate handoffs
* Maintain clean, complete data in internal systems
* Provide feedback on workflows and flag gaps or edge cases
* Handle high volumes of inbound inquiries while maintaining accuracy, clarity, and professionalism

**How the Work Feels**

You’ll likely enjoy this role if you like:

* Helping people feel understood in real time
* Turning unclear situations into clear next steps
* Working within structure while understanding the purpose behind it
* Reducing friction in customer journeys
* Noticing where processes break and suggesting better ways
* Using modern tools (including AI) to work more effectively
* Balancing speed with accuracy in fast-paced environments

* Creating a calm, clear first interaction
* Helping customers feel heard and supported
* Guiding customers toward the right outcome

**Intake & Triage Quality**

* Accurately identifying intent and next steps
* Gathering the right information the first time
* Reducing unnecessary transfers or rework

**Process & Workflow Improvement**

* Using AI-assisted workflows thoughtfully
* Flagging gaps, errors, and edge cases
* Contributing to continuous process improvements

**Data & Handoff Clarity**

* Maintaining clean documentation
* Creating handoffs that downstream teams can act on easily
* Reducing follow-up questions and customer repetition

* Care about creating a great experience for customers
* Think critically about how processes work and how they could be better
* Are adaptable when situations don’t fit neatly into a script
* Enjoy solving small problems that remove friction for others
* Can handle high volumes without losing attention to detail
* Are confident using multiple systems and tools at once
* Stay curious and proactive about improving how work gets done

**Background & Experience**

* Experience in customer operations, intake, support, or coordination roles is helpful
* Experience working with SOPs, CRMs, or workflow tools is a plus
* Comfort using modern tools (including AI-assisted workflows) is preferred
* Strong communication skills, judgment, and a learning mindset matter more than industry background

**What Success Looks Like**

* Customers feel understood and guided from their first interaction
* Customers reach the right team faster with fewer unnecessary transfers
* Sales and Technical teams receive clean, actionable handoffs
* Fewer rework loops or clarification follow-ups
* Workflow outputs improve over time based on frontline feedback
* Customer experience feels smooth even during high-volume periods

PCs shape how customers experience Alpine and how effectively teams can support them. This role directly influences customer satisfaction, internal efficiency, and how well our systems perform.

If you enjoy helping people in real time while also improving how work flows behind the scenes, this role was built for you.

jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

We are seeking a friendly, organized, and dependable **Office Coordinator and Executive Assistant** to help keep our office running smoothly and create a welcoming experience for employees, clients, guests, and vendors.

**This is a full-time, in-person position based in Skokie, IL 60076, Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. This role is** **not** **remote or hybrid.**

**Compensation: $45,000–$60,000 per year, depending on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated ability to independently manage and take ownership of the role. Candidates with strong office-management or administrative experience who can proactively take ownership of office operations may qualify toward the higher end of the range.**

As a key member of the office, you will serve as the first point of contact for visitors and deliveries while providing day-to-day administrative, logistical, and office support. The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of a variety of tasks.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Reception & Visitor Support**

* Greet and welcome guests, clients, and visitors in a friendly and professional manner.
* Receive visitors arriving for meetings and direct them to the appropriate conference room.
* Receive and coordinate deliveries, ensuring packages are routed to the appropriate recipient.
* Help maintain a clean, organized, and welcoming reception area.

**Mail & Deliveries**

* Manage incoming and outgoing mail and packages.
* Sort and distribute incoming mail to employees and departments.
* Coordinate outgoing mail, packages, and shipments.
* Handle occasional local courier tasks as needed.

**Office Events & Employee Engagement**

* Coordinate logistics for employee birthdays, work anniversaries, office lunches, parties, and other team events.
* Coordinate food and beverage orders and assist with in-office setup and cleanup.
* Help ensure office celebrations and employee events run smoothly.
* Contribute to a positive, welcoming, and enjoyable office environment.

**Office Supplies & General Office Support**

* Monitor inventory of office, kitchen, and general supplies and ensure items are consistently stocked.
* Place and coordinate supply orders as needed.
* Help keep shared office spaces organized and well maintained.
* Assist with occasional local pickups, drop-offs, errands, and other ad hoc office needs.
* Provide general administrative and office support as needed.
* Provide administrative support to company executives and leadership as needed, which may include scheduling, coordinating meetings, preparing materials, handling correspondence, making reservations, and assisting with other executive support tasks.

### **Qualifications**

* Previous experience in reception, office administration, hospitality, or a similar role preferred.
* Friendly, professional, and approachable personality.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Reliable, proactive, and comfortable working independently.
* Excellent attention to detail and follow-through.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and adapt to changing needs.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable interacting with employees, clients, vendors, and visitors.
* **Valid driver's license and personal vehicle required. The employee must have reliable access to their own vehicle and be willing to use it for occasional work-related errands, pickups, drop-offs, courier runs, and supply purchases during the workday.**
* Ability to lift and carry typical office supply boxes and event materials when needed.

### **What We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is **organized, personable, resourceful, and dependable**; someone who naturally notices what needs to be done and takes initiative to get it done.

From welcoming a visitor and helping them find the right person, to making sure the office is stocked, mail is handled, and team events are organized, this role is an important part of creating a professional and enjoyable workplace.

If you enjoy being the person others can count on and take pride in keeping an office running smoothly, **we'd love to hear from you.**

jobs.title: Finance & Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Grant Park Music Festival is Chicago’s summer music festival, bringing world-class orchestral and choral performances to Millennium Park and neighborhoods throughout the city. For more than nine decades, the Festival has made exceptional classical music accessible to everyone, presenting free concerts in one of Chicago’s most iconic public spaces while building connections with audiences and communities across the city.
  
  
The Festival is seeking a full-time Finance and Administrative Coordinator to join our mission-driven, collaborative team. This is an excellent opportunity for an organized, resourceful, and proactive administrator who enjoys working across functions and wants to play an important role in the day-to-day operations of a dynamic nonprofit arts organization.
  
  
Reporting to the Chief Financial and Administrative Officer, this position helps ensure that financial processes are accurate and timely, leadership and board activities are well coordinated, and the Festival’s office operates smoothly and efficiently. The Finance and Administrative Coordinator will join a team of 17 year-round staff members dedicated to enriching lives through the power of music.
  
  
In this small and highly collaborative organization, the Coordinator will work closely with Festival leadership and staff while gaining broad experience across finance, nonprofit administration, governance, and operations. The successful candidate will be someone who can manage details carefully, anticipate needs, solve problems independently, and shift comfortably among financial, administrative, operational, and technology-related responsibilities.
  
  
KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
Finance
  
  

* Process accounts payable and accounts and pledges receivable transactions in accordance with established procedures.
* Record deposits in the general ledger and maintain accurate revenue reports.
* Perform monthly bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies.
* Maintain corporate credit card records and reconcile monthly statements.
* Support the annual budgeting and quarterly re-projection processes.

Executive and Board Support
  
  

* Provide administrative and organizational support to the President & CEO, including calendar and meeting coordination, correspondence and materials, travel arrangements, and meeting notes.
* Coordinate logistics for Board of Directors and committee meetings, including scheduling, materials distribution, meeting setup, notetaking, and preparation of formal minutes.
* Coordinate all-staff events, professional development activities, retreats, meetings, and staff recognition.

Office, Facilities, and Technology
  
  

* Serve as a liaison with building management, security, and maintenance to support an effective and well-functioning Festival office.
* Manage office supplies, shared equipment, storage areas, and day-to-day office needs.
* Serve as the primary liaison to the Festival’s outsourced IT services provider and coordinate day-to-day office technology, including hardware, software, cloud files, copiers, printers, and phone systems.
* Provide basic technology training and troubleshooting for staff.
* Manage incoming and outgoing mail and packages, postage, and office access systems.
* Serve as a welcoming first point of contact for visitors, callers, vendors, and constituents.
* Obtain vendor bids and support procurement decisions by comparing pricing, terms, and service levels; negotiate routine vendor terms within established organizational guidelines.

The position also supports seasonal staff onboarding and offboarding, HR recordkeeping, research, mailings, special projects, and other administrative needs at the Festival.
  
  
MINIMUM CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

* At least 2 years of relevant administrative, finance, operations, and/or nonprofit experience.
* At least 1 year of experience with accounts payable, accounts and pledges receivable, account reconciliations, and other general accounting functions.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to handle confidential financial, personnel, donor, board, and organizational information with discretion.
* Strong computer skills and comfort learning and supporting a range of office technology and software systems, including Microsoft 365 applications.
* Ability to work independently, exercise good judgment, identify and resolve routine problems, and know when to seek guidance.
* A collaborative, flexible approach and willingness to contribute wherever needed in a small, fast-moving nonprofit environment.
* Experience in a nonprofit performing arts organization is preferred, but not required.
* Don’t fit all of the qualifications listed above, but feel passionate about the position? Please apply anyway! We are eager to work with enthusiastic and ambitious people. You may be just the right fit for this role.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS
  
  

* $49,000 - $57,000, commensurate with experience.
* Annual benefits package includes 10 days paid vacation, 11 paid holidays, 4 paid personal days, and 12 paid sick days.
* Health insurance for employee and dependents (75% employer paid); dental and vision insurance (25% employer paid); employer-paid life insurance.
* 403(b) retirement plan with 3.75% employer match after one year of employment.
* Complimentary reserved seating for friends and family at Festival performances, steeply discounted staff parking at the Millennium Park Garage, opportunities for free/discounted tickets to partner performances/shows at venues across Chicago.

SCHEDULE & WORK LOCATION
  
  

* This role is based in the Festival’s Chicago office at 205 E. Randolph St, within the Harris Theater at the northern edge of Millennium Park.
* The typical work day is 9am - 5:00pm, with longer days sometimes necessary at certain times of

#### **Part-Time | $28/hour | Approximately 25 hours/week**

Flexible/Hybrid | Uptown, Chicago | Local Travel Required

The Selfhelp Home is a not-for-profit Continuing Care Retirement Community serving older adults for more than 85 years. Our campus includes Independent Living, Assisted Living, and a 5-star Medicare-certified Skilled Nursing Facility. We are rooted in Jewish values and welcome residents of all backgrounds.

We are seeking an outgoing and relationship-driven Community Outreach Coordinator to build community partnerships, increase awareness of Selfhelp, and develop referral opportunities throughout Chicago and surrounding communities.

#### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Build relationships with synagogues, Jewish organizations, healthcare providers, seniorservice organizations, and community partners.
* Represent Selfhelp at community events, senior fairs, networking events, and presentations.
* Develop referral relationships with hospitals, physicians, social workers, discharge planners, hospice, home care, and other healthcare partners.
* Coordinate community outreach events and volunteer opportunities.
* Support marketing and community engagement initiatives.
* Track outreach activities, referrals, leads, and followups in the CRM.
* Assist with promoting Selfhelp's history, programs, and community initiatives.

#### **Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of experience in community outreach, relationshipbased sales, volunteer coordination, or program development.
* Experience in senior living, healthcare, nonprofit, or Jewish community organizations preferred.
* Strong relationshipbuilding, communication, and publicspeaking skills.
* Organized, selfmotivated, and comfortable working independently.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and comfortable using CRM systems.
* Reliable transportation for local travel; mileage reimbursed.
* Availability for occasional evening and weekend events.

This is a part-time position with the potential to grow into a full-time role as the outreach program expands.

The Selfhelp Home is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

### **About the Job**

As a Sales Development Representative at OpenTable, you will play a key role in driving business growth by identifying and generating new restaurant partnerships across the US. Based out of our Chicago office in a hybrid capacity, you will engage prospective clients, educate them on OpenTable's reservation and guest management solutions, and secure qualified meetings for Account Executives. Every member of our team directly impacts how restaurants thrive, empowering operators to streamline their business, enhance guest experiences, and grow their bottom line.

* Collaborate closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to strategize target accounts and optimize lead conversion rates.
* Stay knowledgeable about restaurant industry trends, market dynamics, and competitive offerings to position solutions effectively.

* 1+ years of experience in sales development, business development, or customer-facing sales roles.
* Proven track record of prospecting, qualifying leads, and meeting or exceeding sales targets.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey complex product values clearly.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and sales engagement tools.
* Ability to work in a hybrid capacity from our Chicago office two days per week.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in software-as-a-service (SaaS), hospitality, or restaurant technology industries.
* Familiarity with OpenTable's product platform and restaurant management tools.
* Demonstrated ability to build relationships and communicate effectively with key decision-makers and restaurant owners.
* Experience managing multi-channel outbound campaigns using modern sales technology tools (e.g., Groove).

  + Company-paid subscription to Headspace
  + Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

* Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
* Paid volunteer time
* Focus on your career growth:
* + Development Dollars
  + Leadership development
  + Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
* Travel Discounts
* Employee Resource Groups
* Competitive retirement and health plans

Note for MA applicants: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this United States based role is $55,000 to $65,000 plus quarterly sales bonus.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits.

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Build and own logistics at Planture US.** Planture is looking for a hands-on Logistics Coordinator to take ownership of logistics for our US office. You’ll be the first person in this role, with the opportunity to shape how the function works and build a strong domestic logistics network as our business grows and have close connections with our HQ office in Amsterdam.

This is a role for someone who enjoys keeping shipments moving, staying on top of contracts and schedules, and stepping in when plans change. Logistics can be unpredictable, so you’ll need to be comfortable solving problems quickly while keeping customers and colleagues informed.

**What you’ll do**

* Coordinate imports through our customer broker, including customs clearance, drayage and delivery to external warehouses.
* Coordinate outbound shipments from our warehouses to customers.
* Organize, monitor and administratively process import orders.
* Track delivery schedules, transport status and logistics positions, and act quickly when something is delayed or at risk.
* Manage logistics contracts and service agreements, keeping terms, rates and performance under review.
* Stay in regular contact with brokers, carriers, warehouses, logistics department in Amsterdam and other logistics partners.
* Request, compare and negotiate transportation rates and service agreements.
* Act as the link between logistics partners, customers and Planture’s commercial team.
* Help the commercial team provide customers with clear, timely updates and practical solutions.
* Identify bottlenecks and improve logistics processes and systems.
* Build and develop Planture’s network of domestic logistics partners.

**What we’re looking for**

You’re an independent and organized logistics professional who takes ownership and enjoys making things work. You can keep track of the details while also seeing where a process can be improved. When a shipment runs into trouble, you stay calm, communicate clearly and focus on the next steps.

**You’ll bring:**

* Around two years of relevant logistics experience.
* Experience with international logistics and order fulfilment.
* Knowledge of customs clearance and import procedures; experience with US imports is a strong advantage.
* Strong analytical skills and close attention to detail.
* A structured, accurate and well-organized way of working.
* Clear communication skills and confidence dealing with customers and external partners.
* A commercial, solution-focused mindset.
* The ability to work independently, set priorities and take ownership.
* Availability to work five days per week.

**What we offer:**

* The opportunity to take ownership of logistics at Planture US and build the function as it grows.
* A broad, hands-on role with direct involvement in logistics decisions, partner relationships, customer support and process improvements.
* Close collaboration with Planture’s commercial team and logistics partners.
* Salary between $40.000 - $80.000 depending on relevant experience

**Why join Planture?**

You’ll have a direct impact on Planture’s day-to-day logistics operations. You won’t just process orders: you’ll help shape transportation decisions, manage logistics partners and contracts, support customers and improve the way logistics works across the US business.

If you’re ready to take responsibility, solve real-world logistics challenges and build something from the ground up, we’d like to hear from you.

Pay: $40,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Language:

* English (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Assist Community Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

**The Michaels Organization is a national leader in residential real estate offering full-service capabilities in development, property management, construction, and investment. At Michaels, our teammates strive to fulfill our promise of creating communities that lift lives – ones that jumpstart housing, education, civic engagement, and neighborhood prosperity. With this passion at the forefront of our business, Michaels teammates can be proud to be a part of the extraordinary, every day.**

The Assistant Community Manager, under the supervision of the Community Manager is responsible for assisting in all phases of the operation of a property, including, but not limited to, the general administration, leasing, and maintenance of the property. The Assistant Community Manager may also participate in budget preparation and control, and direction and control of all resources of the property.

Responsibilities:

1. Perform recertification interviews with residents, complete paperwork, system entry and submit to corporate office.

2. Track rental inquiries from referrals, walk-ins and phone contacts. Accept, date/time stamp and log all applications for unit rental.

3. Show vacant units, market property amenities.

4. Maintain knowledge of all procedures for Accounts Payable and Receivables, assist Community Manager with collections efforts.

5. Assist Community Manager with filing court documents for eviction; attend court hearing if Community Manager is not available.

6. Executes marketing campaigns for leasing of rental units, including promotion, tours of property and rental units. Prepares, processes and modifies lease agreements and related forms. Maintains knowledge of competition and market conditions effecting leasing and operations and makes adjustments to the business and marketing models to ensure the Company remains competitive and in compliance with applicable federal and state laws.

7. Coordinate with property messaging service to retrieve messages and follow-up with calls if necessary.

8. Remain current with all applicable laws and regulations relating to residential rental properties, and maintain knowledge of current company processes and procedures.

9. Assist Community Manager with ordering office supplies for property when necessary.

10. Initiate, track and close work orders utilizing systems for property.

11. Assist Community Manager with other tasks and duties as required.

Qualifications:

**Required Experience:**  
One or more years’ experience with residential real estate management.
  
Tax Credit, Section 8 and/or Public Housing experience preferred.

**Required Education/Training:**  
High School Diploma or equivalent required.  
Two or more years of college preferred.  
After hiring, will complete all company required certification training and testing

**Required Skills and Abilities:**  
Professional appearance and the ability to resolve conflicts in a professional manner.  
Excellent organizational skills with attention to detail.

**Working Conditions:**

* Primarily an office environment, but will need the ability to meet residents in their units, show units to potential residents, walk around to inspect the property, often in a multi-story facility including climbing stairs. May work around cleaning solvents, paint fumes and landscaping chemicals.
* Evening and weekend work may be required.

**Salary Range Information:**

The range displayed on each job posting reflects the targeted base salary for the position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

**Rewards & Benefits:**

We know Michaels’ promise of lifting lives starts with our teammates, so making sure every single teammate is happy, healthy, and set up for a successful future is important to us. As part of our team, you will enjoy a competitive wage, a comprehensive benefit package which includes Medical, Dental, Vision, prescription, etc., generous paid time off, a 401 (k) plan with a company match, and so much more. We believe in education – and in taking care of our own – so as an added incentive your children will be able to apply for the Michaels Employee Scholarship Program.

* Help make the world a better place in a team-oriented environment.
* Grow with our organization through various professional development opportunities.
* Collaborate and thrive in a company culture where all are welcome

Michaels teammates make a difference in the lives of residents, colleagues, and the communities where we live and work every day. To learn more about the total rewards we offer please visit our website.

Come join our team. You’re going to love it here!

Salary Range: $20.00 per hour

We don’t shy away from the unknown and thrive on the speed of business. The Assistant Media Planner/Buyer is responsible for providing administrative and analytical support in the development, execution, and maintenance of media plans while acquiring a working knowledge of cross-department collaboration and problem solving within a fast-paced, full-service ad agency. The Assistant Media Planner/Buyer works closely with media managers to develop and implement media campaigns tailored to reach specific audiences as efficiently and effectively as possible, taking into account current media consumption habits to ensure scale and relevance of each media buy.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Work with media team managers on development, negotiation, implementation, tracking, measurement, and optimization of media campaigns
* Develop and present POVs, media analyses, and recommendations to agency team and clients
* Meet with vendor representatives to further knowledge of available media opportunities and assess them for possible inclusion in future media planning
* Utilize consumer data and media measurement tools such as Kantar, MRI-Simmons, and SEMRush to conduct research and generate appropriate reports (target audience development and media consumption, competitive analysis, performance tracking, budget reporting, etc.)
* Reconcile monthly billing invoices and discrepancies to ensure agency and client budget compliance
* Ensure orders are sent and received by agency vendors
* Become proficient at navigating self-serve media platforms (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Facebook Ads, Manager, LinkedIn Ads, etc.) to aid in setup of campaigns, monitor spend, and access reporting to analyze performance of in-market campaigns
* Compile media reports from various software and social platforms
* Coordinate deliverables with account team, including collecting creative specs, relaying creative deadlines, and assisting in campaign setup and QA
* General assistance to the Media Department as needed

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelors degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, or a related field
* 1-2 years of experience in media planning, advertising, or a related role
* Fast learner who easily adapts to various agency and client demands
* A strong work ethic with the self-motivation needed to exceed expectations
* Familiarity with digital media buying platforms (Google Ads, Facebook Ads, etc.) preferred
* Knowledge of programmatic advertising and media buying processes
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Exemplary organizational and multi-tasking abilities
* The drive and ability to prioritize while working on multiple assignments under deadline pressures
* A passion for media, advertising and staying updated with industry trends

* Hybrid Work Schedule
* Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance available on the first day of employment
* FSA/HSA’s
* 401k with an employer match
* Unlimited PTO
* Flex Friday’s
* 13 Holiday’s including time off between Christmas and New Years
* Paid Maternity and Paternity Leave
* Strong culture and supportive working environment

jobs.title: Client Experience & Wellness Concierge (formerly Freeze & Float)
jobs.description:
***Nuva Haus*** *formerly Freeze & Float · River North, Chicago, IL*

***About Nuva Haus***

Nuva Haus is Chicago's destination for longevity and advanced wellness — a modern, considered space in River North where science-backed treatments meet genuine hospitality. We offer hormone optimization, peptide therapy, IV drips, aesthetics, and recovery modalities designed to help clients feel and perform at their best.

We're building a team that takes the client experience as seriously as the clinical one. That means every touchpoint — from the first call to the final follow-up — should feel intentional, warm, and exceptional.

***The Role***

This is a front-of-house role with real ownership. As our Client Experience & Wellness Concierge, you are the connective tissue of Nuva Haus — the person who makes clients feel known, supported, and excited to come back. You will work across every service line, build lasting relationships with our client base, and play a direct role in the growth and retention of the practice.

This is not a passive desk role. The right person is curious about wellness, energized by human connection, and brings a hospitality mindset to every interaction — whether that's greeting a new client, following up after a treatment, or helping someone understand which protocol is right for them.

***What You Will Own***

*Client Relationship & Retention*

* Greet every client with genuine warmth — remember names, preferences, and treatment history
* Drive rebooking and retention through personalized follow-up calls, texts, and progress check-ins
* Build long-term client relationships that support wellness goals and membership growth

*Clinic Coordination & Flow*

* Prepare guests for services including IV drips, injections, aesthetics, and recovery therapies
* Coordinate appointments and manage day-of scheduling with precision and calm
* Support room turnover, setup, and clinic cleanliness standards

*Client Education & Sales Support*

* Educate clients on our full service menu, wellness protocols, and membership offerings (full training provided)
* Make thoughtful product and service recommendations aligned to each client's goals
* Contribute to a culture of excellence, continuous learning, and team performance

***Who You Are***

* You have a genuine enthusiasm for wellness, longevity, or health optimization — and you bring that energy to every conversation
* You are warm, professional, and instinctively hospitable — clients leave your interactions feeling taken care of
* You are organized, reliable, and calm under pressure in a fast-moving clinical environment
* You can hold a real conversation about treatments like NAD+, IV therapy, peptide protocols, and aesthetics — or you're highly motivated to learn
* Experience in wellness, medspa, aesthetics, hospitality, or client services is a strong advantage — not a requirement
* A licensed esthetician or medical assistant background is a plus, not a prerequisite

*We will train the right person. What we can't train is genuine care, professional presence, and the instinct to make every client feel like a priority.*

***Compensation & Benefits***

* **Pay:** $21–$30 per hour, based on experience
* **Bonus:** Commission structure and client retention bonuses available
* **Discounts:** Generous staff discounts on services and wellness products
* **Schedule:** Full-time and part-time available · Weekend rotation required
* **Training:** Ongoing access to cutting-edge treatments and professional development
* **Environment:** Beautiful, modern wellness space in River North with a supportive, growth-oriented team
* **Health Insurance:** Explored at the 6-month milestone for eligible team members

***How to Apply***

Send your resume and a brief note — not a form cover letter — to jobs@nuvahaus.com. Tell us: what draws you to the intersection of wellness and client experience, and what kind of impression you want to leave on the people you work with every day.

LinkedIn profiles welcome. We read everything we receive.

*Nuva Haus · River North, Chicago IL 60654 · In-Person Role*

Pay: $21.00 - $30.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* On-the-job training

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.description:
Convoso is a leading AI-powered contact center platform purpose-built for revenue teams. Since 2006, Convoso has remained at the forefront of innovation, consistently developing solutions to drive customer growth while supporting adherence to regulatory standards.

**Who We Are:**

While headquartered in Los Angeles, the Convoso team can be found around the globe working in either a hybrid or remote capacity. Awarded as a "best place to work" company, our culture fosters team integrity, positive persistence, and continuous growth.  
  
Our core platform powers successful sales teams across multiple industries, giving our customers a competitive edge and streamlined productivity. With built-in Al and automations, our product is a premium offering in a competitive space. We continue to grow our product capabilities to better serve our current customers and to expand into newer markets.  
  
Convoso is looking for people who are excited about technology and innovation. We are a company of motivated team players with diverse backgrounds driving accelerated growth in a supportive, positive culture.

Most roles at Convoso function as "hybrid" with some opportunities for travel to in-person business events and company meetings. For remote positions, Convoso's U.S. hiring is open to candidates residing anywhere within the United States.

**The Job:**

The SDR, Outbound owns self-sourced pipeline generation into a targeted list of named accounts. This is an outbound-first role. The incumbent builds their own account and contact lists, multithreads into multiple stakeholders per account, and converts cold conversations into qualified meetings for the Account Executive team. Inbound lead coverage may be assigned during the current transition period, but outbound production is the primary measure of the role.

**Responsibilities summary:**

  

* Build, own and maintain a targeted list of named accounts. Research accounts and contacts independently rather than working an assigned queue.
* Generate self-sourced pipeline through high-volume, high-quality outbound calling, email and LinkedIn outreach.
* Multithread into target accounts, developing and maintaining multiple stakeholder relationships per account over time.
* Design, run and refine outbound campaigns, cadences and sequences. Test messaging and adjust based on results.
* Qualify prospects against Convoso's current ICP and qualification criteria, and pre-wire and hand off qualified meetings to the Account Executive team.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, disposition reasons and account ownership.
* Provide inbound lead coverage as assigned during the current transition period. Inbound coverage is secondary to outbound production.
* Stay informed of all new product information.
* Be accountable for your outbound targets.
* Other duties as assigned

**Who You Are:**

* 3+ years in an outbound-focused SDR or BDR role in B2B SaaS, with a demonstrable record of self-sourced pipeline. Inbound lead-response experience alone will not substitute.
* Proven success cold calling at volume, including the ability to open and hold a conversation with a prospect who is not expecting the call.
* Experience with account-based, multithreaded prospecting into mid-market or enterprise accounts.
* Demonstrated ability to build target lists and conduct account research independently, without a pre-assigned lead queue.
* Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills. Professional presence on video and by phone, including the ability to take video calls from a quiet, distraction-free environment.
* Outstanding organization and follow-up skills, as well as strong prospecting skills.
* Strong understanding of outbound pipeline generation processes and the metrics that govern them.
* Proficiency with Salesforce, Outreach or a comparable sales engagement platform, and Gong or a comparable conversation intelligence platform.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant work experience.
* Enthusiastic and vibrant attitude.

**Work Perks Worth The Hype:**

* Competitive compensation package
* Stock options

new_jobs.description:

### **Company Description**

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.

### **Job Description**

**Primary Function of Position**  
The U.S. ION® Endoluminal Sales Associate reports to the U.S. ION® Endoluminal Program Manager (EPM). The ION® Endoluminal Sales Associate plays a critical role in the early adoption of the Ion® platform in expanding access to minimally invasive care for lung biopsy. This individual will be primarily focused on supporting early sustainable users and programs and the development of KOL’s and programs that can highlight the early clinical, economic and strategic value of ION®.

* Provide procedural support to new users to promote safety and effective progression through their learning curves
* Support training activities to include in-services, training labs, attend first case series and development of teams and programs
* Become a clinical expert in the pulmonary oncology space
* Work alongside ESR’s to collaborate with senior hospital staff and key physicians in the development and execution of a plan to effectively integrate Ion® at new customer sites, ensuring ongoing commitment to and utilization of the system
* Facilitate critical user and procedural data capture to create effective QTI and benchmarking metrics
* Collaboration with daVinci local sales teams to ensure consistent alignment and communication with internal and external stakeholders

new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative – Aerospace & Space
new_jobs.description:
**Overview**

BSU Electronics is a 35+ year old, ITAR-registered contract electronics manufacturer building high-reliability PCBAs for government agencies and advanced-technology OEMs.

We build mission critical parts for underwater autonomous naval vessels, moon landings, anti-missile drones and roller coaster rides, to name a few. Our engineering heavy team take on the complex builds that other shops turn away. NPI? Quick turn? We’ve got you.

Few places in the world concentrate as much space and aerospace hardware demand as El Segundo and the South Bay. It’s one of our fastest growing geographies, and that’s the territory you'll own. This is an exceptional opportunity to ride the unprecedented wave of investment and innvoation in SoCal right now.

Our ideal candidate has spent a few years in space or aerospace, in engineering, test, quality, program management, supply chain, or sales. You know how flight and defense hardware gets bought, who has a say, and what a supplier has to prove before earning a PO.

Now you want a role where your network and your initiative *are* the job. No internal politics, red tape or confused incentives- you plan your time and eat what you kill.

**What You'll Do**

* Become a known face in El Segundo's aerospace community by attending industry events, meetups, conferences, and customer sites, and following up relentlessly.
* Build your own pipeline from your network, AI-driven prospecting tools, and the phone. This is not an inside-sales seat, and there's no inherited book.
* Turn relationships into RFQs. Your core measure is qualified RFQs from new California based customers.
* Partner with BSU engineering and quality to represent our capabilities credibly to technical buyers, from program engineers to supply chain leads.
* Carry opportunities from first conversation through qualification to a quoted, PO-ready RFQ.
* Travel as needed: mostly local face time across SoCal, plus periodic trips to our Austin facility and trade shows. Expand across the west coast over time at your discretion.

**Who You Are**

* Exceptionally proactive. You don't wait for leads to show up. You walk into the room, introduce yourself, and follow up the next morning.
* Technology extrovert. You love meeting new builders and innovators and learning about their products, getting under the hood to understand what they need from their supplier and showing we’ve got it.
* In the game. 2+ years of experience in the space or aerospace industry under your belt. You already have a network in the El Segundo / South Bay aerospace community, and you're excited to keep building it.
* Sales or business development experience is a plus, not a requirement. Show us a track record of initiative, such as an idea you sold, a project you pushed through, or a goal you outworked everyone to hit.
* An engineering degree or technical training is a plus. You’re comfortable having early stage conversations about products, BOMs and build plans before it’s ready to hand over to our quoting team.
* U.S. citizenship required. No exceptions- customers often require this before you can visit their facility.

**Compensation & Ramp**

* Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission, with significant upside tied to hitting RFQ and revenue milestones.

Pay: $100,000.00 - $250,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Are you a U.S. citizen? This is a requirement for this role.
* Do you have at least 2 years of experience working in the space or aerospace industry?
* Do you live in, or within a reasonable commute of, El Segundo, CA?
* Do you currently have professional contacts at aerospace or space companies in the El Segundo / South Bay area?
* Have you been involved in the RFQ or supplier selection process, on either the buying or selling side?

Work Location: Hybrid remote in El Segundo, CA 90245

Support the Manager of Men’s Leather Goods & Accessories in daily merchandising activities, such as shop-to-shop product transfers, consolidations, inventory replenishments, and assortment planning for commercial events.

Assists the Manager in analyzing the Men’s Leather Goods and Accessories business, with a focus on weekly sales performance, trends, and generating qualitative insights based on quantitative assessments.

* Analyze sales performance by product category / material / function / store to prepare necessary reports on a weekly basis

* Provide support to the Retail Merchandising team in the preparation of orders for the US, Canadian, and Latin American markets, including unit entry, sizing scale, and by-store allocation
* Develop analyses required by the Merchandising Manager for specific focus areas week to week
* Maintain regular communications with stores in regards to product transfers, seasonal price changes, style cancellations, deliveries, etc.

* Proficient in Microsoft Office Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, particularly as it relates to managing and updating large datasets in Excel
